reviews.comment: Great house, perfect location, just needed more snow!
We loved the house and the location.
Loved the home! I stayed two years in a row. We did not book year three because of cost. The cost went up nearly 50% from one year to the next. I'm priced out!!!
Amazing place! Couldn't be a better spot in Breckenridge!
Incredible location! Fantastic private beach from which we saw fish, crabs, seals, porpoise, Bald Eagles and even a Gray Whale!

Outstanding property! As advertised. Plenty of space for congregating/solo time and for children to run and play. Bonus: beach access with the gorgeous cove and saw a gray whale (twice) and a bald eagle! Magical!

The check in procedure was easy. The house was very clean except for the basement bathroom, under the beds and bunks may have been slept in before. The outside fire pit needed propane and it was brought to us in a very timely manner. The grill was very high quality and worked well. The view was outstanding and a nice easy path to the water. The kitchen was equipped very nicely and a very ample supply of condiments was available. A house instruction book should have been available. None of us could find the thermostat and when we found it, it took a while to figure out how to use it. The sink in the downstairs bathroom had a mild leak and we had to put a wash cloth around it. Overall a very good property and would recommend it!

Perfect venue for our family of 11 - ample bedrooms/baths, HUGE cooking area and great room, everything top notch. Clean and new, AMAZING VIEWS and BEACH ACCESS. We all wanted to stay longer. Oh, and huge extra credit for the bespoke antiques which are layered throughout this newly renovated home. Serious design and character :)
Beautiful property on Whidbey Island in between Coupeville and Langley. Stunning waterfront views and a modern house make this house perfect for large groups. Would stay again!

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.comment: "We had such an incredible stay! The home was perfect for our large group of 14. There was plenty of space for everyone. The backyard felt like our own private resort. We really enjoyed the large kitchen and outdoor BBQ area. The beds and linens were comfortable, A/C worked great, and everything was spotless. I highly recommend this home. 10/10 would definitely stay here again."

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.comment: "Jen and the homes (we rented the Dome as well for our group) were awesome! Super communicative, very flexible, and both homes were outstanding with amazing outdoor spaces (pools, hot tubs) and scenery (mountains, SoCal plants/succulents/cactus/trees). Our large group was more than delighted in the homes and the overall experience they contributed to."

reviews.title: Loved!
reviews.comment: "Base Camp was incredible. We absolutely loved it. We had 7 couples staying for a 50th birthday party and it was amazing. We will stay here again! The pool was incredible. We hiked the trails right out of the gate. We had a private chef come and it was wonderful."

reviews.title: Great for Big Groups!
reviews.comment: "This house was perfect for a big group. They had everything thought out. From plenty of pool towels to a pump for our pool floaties, we were very pleased by the attention to detail. I would recommend bringing your own pillow as ALL the pillows were oversized and uncomfortable. Not sure who uses pillows that big. The other thing to note is that 3 of the rooms were not part of the main house and had their own entrances."

reviews.title: Cool
reviews.comment: "Awesome spot!!"

reviews.title: Great!!
reviews.comment: "This place was amazing. Home was spacious and beautiful. It is equipped with all that is needed to cook which was a plus. Pools were extremely clean and our family had a great Fourth of July weekend. Also firework show was enjoyable from the home we didn’t need to leave. Highly recommended this home for family gatherings it accommodates extremely well."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "This house was beautiful and looked just like the photos! We had a fantastic weekend. The only improvement I think would be worth investing in, is one of the bedrooms (the casita adjacent to the master) doesn’t get good air and on a summer day is very hot. Still would very much recommend!"

reviews.title: Perfect Weekend
reviews.comment: "The home was perfect for the weekend and Jen and her team were responsive, flexible and made it so easy!"

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.comment: "One of the best airbnbs I’ve stayed at. We came here with some friends and family for a long weekend and it comfortably fit all of us and had everything you’d need plus some. The house and yard were stunning. I can’t think of a single critique. I’d absolutely stay here again."

reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.comment: "Family celebration with adults and kids. The pool was the hit with all and the beautiful setting. Kitchen very well equipped. Management responded quickly to questions and sent maintenance when needed. (Minor problem). Will definitely return if given the opportunity."

reviews.title: Serene
reviews.comment: "We loved the mountain view and the desert serenity. We will come back!"

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.comment: "My family spent 3 glorious days at Base Camp. The home itself was perfectly situated in Palm Desert near shops and restaurants, and easily accommodated 16 of us. What I liked best was the quick response from the company whenever we needed something. Everyone had a memorable time at my 90th birthday."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Amazing location, beautiful house"

reviews.title: Perfect Stay!
reviews.comment: "A dream come true! The pictures don’t do it justice. Beautifully equipped and so peaceful."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "A perfect weekend trip"

reviews.title: A Blast!
reviews.comment: "Wonderful private location; excellent communication from host. Great stay, thank you!"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "We were having a get together of siblings and spouses and we all enjoyed the house. Wellappointed kitchen and great space inside and out for a large group. Loved the pool!"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: 5 Stars

reviews.title: Amazing Bachelorette!
reviews.comment: "We had an amazing stay at basecamp for my bachelorette party! There was plenty of space for our group and everyone felt super comfortable and spaced out. The house was clean, beds were comfortable, the amenities were amazing and the host communication was clear and easy. I’d love to come back to Basecamp in the future!"

reviews.title: Highly Recommend!
reviews.comment: "We celebrated my mom’s 70th birthday at Basecamp and it was absolutely incredible! The property was beautiful, spacious, and perfect for our family gathering. Everything was well-kept, thoughtfully designed, and made for such a memorable celebration. We all had a great time and would definitely recommend it for any special occasion or getaway.The only small thing I wish the property had on hand was a broom and a pair of scissors — otherwise, everything was perfect.Thank you for helping make such a milestone celebration so special!"

reviews.title: Unforgettable Stay!
reviews.comment: "Came for a bachelorette trip and it truly was an amazing experience. Lots of room and lots of things to do on the property. Jen was super helpful with decor, chef, and things to do recommendations."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "The property is spacious and well stocked. The outside offers two pools and everything you could ask for to have a relaxing stay. The management is very responsive. We had a group of 8 and we had a great time. We will come again."

reviews.title: Impeccable!
reviews.comment: "It is truly hard to put into words how perfect this home was for my sister’s bachelorette, and how seamless the host made our stay. If you are hesitating at all, book now, you will not regret it! The home is exactly as pictured, if not better in real life. Jen and her team were impeccable hosts, always responsive and were so thoughtful, even leaving crumbl cookies for the bride at check in. If I had any concerns or questions, they were addressed within minutes, no matter the time of day. The property is private and safe but close to a Target and shopping center so it was truly the best of both worlds. We opted to hire the private chef one night and enjoyed an amazing dinner under the stars. This trip will be one we will always remember and we are grateful to this team for making it so perfect!"

reviews.title: Luxurious
reviews.comment: "The house is incredibly luxurious. There were a couple bugs with the Sonos sound system and with the front gate but the company was sent out to fix the errors in good time. Overall had a very good experience and appreciated how communicative the team was. The house and backyard are gorgeous and close to restaurants grocery stores and about 35 min from downtown Palm Springs."

reviews.title: Loved!
reviews.comment: "This was a fantastic property. The home, yard, and surrounding area were all awesome. A great space to have friends and family enjoy outdoors and meals together. Highly recommended. Also hiking the great desert trails by walking out the front door."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "This was our group's second time staying at Base Camp, and we were so happy to come back. The tranquil vibe captured the essence of our retreat weekend. All the rooms are well designed and kept, and the little details, like the welcome Crumbl cookies, were such a nice touch. The house is stocked with most everything that you need, so there was nothing to worry about. Our team can't wait to come back next year!"

reviews.title: Great House
reviews.comment: "Great house for a big group. We were 4 families and the house never felt crowded. The casita rooms are in the garage conversion so that’s something to be aware of. They felt a little removed and not as chic as the rest of the house. We stuck some of the older kids in there. The kitchen has literally everything you could ever need in terms of equipment and it was a pleasure to cook meals in. We also loved the outdoor grill. The neighborhood has a strict noise policy so this is not the house to come to if you plan on playing music past 9pm but we appreciated the quiet. The location is wonderful. It’s within easy driving distance from shops and restaurants but feels remote once you’re on the property."

reviews.title: Gorgeous & Private!
reviews.comment: "The property is absolutely gorgeous and extremely private. It’s a wonderful location, with a beautiful and close view of the mountains. We had a wonderful time. The host is very responsive. The pools are beautiful, the fire pit was cozy, we had fun grilling dinner in the back yard and even the hammocks were a great way to unwind. Two minor things to be aware of: to get there, you drive for a (very) short distance onto a dirt road. We thought we had to be going the wrong way, but we weren’t (Jen’s directions are clear on this). The house is that private! Also, since the house is quite close to the mountains, the sun drops behind the mountains earlier in the day. We visited around Christmas and the sun was behind the mountains by around 3:30pm which made us a bit chillier outdoors. As the days get longer, that would be different and it’d even be an advantage in the summer months. Overall, we had a great time as a family and would love to do it again."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Great place. Spacious, convenient and clean. Fully stocked kitchen. Highly recommended."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: 5 Stars

reviews.title: Fantastic Stay!
reviews.comment: "We had a fantastic stay at this property as a group of 10. The yard is beautiful and secluded. There is lots to do around the property and the beach volleyball court was a hit. We loved the mountain hikes that are right off the property. The hosts were very responsive and we were able to sort out anything we needed. The property is in an excellent location very close to lots of shopping. We would stay here again, and we highly recommend this property to others."

reviews.title: Beautiful Home
reviews.comment: "We had a really wonderful time staying here. The home is beautiful and was able to fit our entire group comfortably. The pool and backyard area was perfect to just relax and enjoy our time. Communication with the host was excellent, she always got back to us quickly. The only thing to be aware of is Palm Springs has very strict noise rules and this home is in a location where sound can travel. Even with that would totally book this place again and go back. Relaxing and beautiful, we had a great time."

reviews.title: Perfect Family Trip!
reviews.comment: "The house was perfect for our multi-generational family get together! Lots of communal and private space, not to mention all the fun games and amenities on site, from the hot tub and pools to the bocce court/ping pong table. Jen was very responsive to all our needs during our stay from providing softer pillows to quickly replacing a broken coffee grinder. She also recommended a private chef and other services prior to getting there - and that made organizing the trip super easy. The setting is beautiful, quiet and feels quite remote. Yet, whole foods, target and lots of restaurants are within 5-10 mins drive. We really enjoyed our stay and totally recommend this spot! It's our first time to Palm Desert and we're looking forward to future visits."

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.comment: "We highly recommend this property for family, friends, or business gatherings. Truly a spectacular location with ALL the amenities. We had an amazing trip and made many wonderful memories. Thank you for opening your beautiful home up to our family!"

reviews.title: Will be Back!
reviews.comment: "Jen is really great! Very responsive and accommodating! Will be staying here again when we come back to the desert."

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.comment: "Was a relaxing place for a getaway, the host responded in a timely manner, and sent someone to ask us what we need help with, a chance to come back again, thanks this team for giving us an unforgettable holiday."

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.comment: "Everything about this house and the property managers was amazing. They were super responsive, accommodating and super nice. It made the experience that much better. It was the perfect spot for my bachelorette party and I will 100% be back. The house has privacy but is close to the downtown palm desert area. The only thing that would be better is the barroom situation got a little tight at times. But there was 14 girls in one house."

reviews.title: Blown Away!
reviews.comment: "I had extremely high hopes for this property and they were blown away! My guests were so impressed and I think everyone was really comfortable. There were so many activities at the bnb and we even went for a morning hike on a trailhead just paces from the front gate. It felt like a private resort. Chic and romantic. I hate that we have to go home."

reviews.title: A Treat!
reviews.comment: "If you like places that are perfect, Base Camp is for you. The setting, the pool, the outdoor amenities, the beauty, the proximity to hiking but also to El Paseo/stores and restaurants, the on top of it property management - This house is our favorite and we have stayed all over the area in some pretty classy rentals. You’re in for a treat."

reviews.title: Beautiful Family Trip
reviews.comment: "Place was beautiful and great for larger families and friends. Host was very responsive for any questions I had. Beautiful mountain views, also the hike trails in back of the home. Definitely coming back."

reviews.title: Amazing Memories
reviews.comment: "A great, relaxing location where my family got to create amazing memories. Spacious and comfortable."

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.comment: "What a great experience, beautiful house, beautiful outdoor, beautiful set up. Always responding, at any time, everything we needed they where there for us. The house was clean and the location view is amazing. Also it is very close to the stores if you need something. We want to thank you guys for that great experience 🙏🏻🙏🏻"

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.comment: "We absolutely enjoyed our time here. The property itself is situated on a beautiful lot that backs up to private mountains. The home is stunning inside and out with beautiful design and very comfortable living areas. Both kids and adults spent time in both beautiful pools and we will definitely be returning at some point. Jen is one of the most responsive and professional property managers we have ever dealt with. She was unbelievably responsive and so eager to communicate. This is an A+ property and organization. Highly recommend."

reviews.title: Clean and Beautiful!
reviews.comment: "Jen, Your place was perfect for our mother daughter getaway. Your home is private, clean and decorated so beautifully. Can't wait to go back one day. Your team was incredibly responsive. Thank you for everything!"

reviews.title: Felt Like Celebrities!!
reviews.comment: "Everything was perfect!! Felt like celebrities!! There were 9 of us in all and had an enjoyable relaxing stay.. the only exception would be to note the many (one) steps up and down inside and out.. we were so busy looking we almost broke ankle. To rectify the situation we put blue tape in the step so as not to fall.."

reviews.title: Luxurious Living
reviews.comment: "Just a few words sum up our visit—luxurious living surrounded by breathtaking scenery. We had a full house of family and friends, including an infant, and there was plenty of room for us to spread out but also come together in the living and pool areas. Beds were very comfortable, and the kitchen accommodated multiple cooks. The master bath was like a spa. Each day ended with conversation by the pool in the cool night air. The home’s location couldn’t have been more perfect."

reviews.title: Magical!
reviews.comment: “This house exceeded our expectations! Honestly the pictures are gorgeous but it was even more magical than we anticipated. There were 17 of us for a bachelorette and we all fit comfortably and sharing bathrooms was easy. The pools and views were magical. I grew up in the desert and even I was blown away! We were able to walk to the Cross Hike and get little items delivered to the house if we needed anything. Each and every one of us said this is a house we’d come back to whether for a friend vaca or spring break with the kiddos! Jen and her team were super responsive, kind and proactive. The best Airbnb experience we’ve ever had. Thank YOU Team TRAVLR!”

reviews.title: Nice Location
reviews.comment: "everything is very nice, nice location for Coachella. Nice place for friends to stay together, better than hotel especially during Coachella time. They also provide late check out if available which is very awesome."

reviews.title: Luxurious!
reviews.comment: "beautiful, scenic, quiet, luxurious. Perfect pool and spa. Amazing access to hiking trails. Great mattresses. Close to shops and restaurants. Unparalleled views. Everything our family (including teenager and senior) wants from a desert vacation house. Run don’t walk!"
"The home was beautiful, and Jen was incredibly responsive and helpful in the booking and planning process. 10/10 experience!"

reviews.title: Gorgeous & Private!
reviews.comment: "This place was absolutely gorgeous. We celebrated my husband's 40th birthday here with a group of friends and it was great. Enough bedrooms and privacy for everyone. My one piece of feedback is that I wish there were more bathrooms. It's a little odd that there are only 4 bathrooms for the number of bedrooms and the price. But the outside situation more than makes up for it. We did everything: played volleyball, relaxed by the pool, swam, played corn hole and ping pong, bbq'd, hung out by the fire pit, rested in the hammocks, walked to the great hiking trails just out the back gate. The place is truly amazing, and there was always enough space for everyone to do what they wanted. It was the perfect getaway, really quiet and relaxing at night. The communication was so kind and responsive. We accidentally got locked out of one of the rooms and they sent someone at midnight to help us out. Truly above and beyond!"

reviews.title: Natural Beauty
reviews.comment: "Base Camp is at the foot of many hiking trails in Palm Desert, the location and the house are both amazing. The outdoor space is full of natural beauty. We stayed there for a few days and immediately booked a return stay. This house is our favourite."

reviews.title: Exceptional Views
reviews.comment: "We had a fantastic stay at Base Camp. We had a large group of adults & children but everyone had a comfortable bed to sleep in and places to gather. Everyone loved the pool & hot tub, volleyball court, outdoor fire pit, bocci ball court and close proximity to great hiking. The kitchen was large & fully stocked. The views from the backyard were exceptional. We felt like there were no other houses or people around us but yet we could walk or drive to restaurants & grocery stores nearby. Also, the support from the property management company was superb. We had a couple of questions & issues that got resolved immediately. We highly recommend this property."

reviews.title: Work Offsite
reviews.comment: "Awesome place for a work offsite. Had a great stay."

reviews.title: Thanksgiving Paradise
reviews.comment: We spent Thanksgiving week here with our 4 adult children, their spouses and children and had a blast. We rented cars but barely used them because miles of hiking trails are right out the door. The weather was perfect and so were the pool and spa. With the volleyball and bocce ball courts and the fire pit it felt like a resort we never wanted to leave. So we really didn't! My only caution is to make sure the bathroom setup works for you. It was fine for us but might be a little cozy for some.

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Great spot!"

reviews.title: Amazing Property
reviews.comment: "Amazing property. Everything exactly as advertised. We will definitely be back"

reviews.title: Gorgeous House
reviews.comment: "The house was absolutely gorgeous. We went for my son’s birthday and he had the best time swimming all day. The beds are really comfy and everything was super clean. The outdoor is extremely big and has some really great views perfect for a morning cup of coffee outside. The house on the inside was really spacious and beautiful. The kitchen was well equipped as well. We look forward to booking this house again in the future."

reviews.title: Beautiful House
reviews.comment: "This house is beautiful and EXACTLY as pictured. It's perfect for a large group. The AC worked great in all rooms, the sound system throughout the house was awesome, the kitchen was fully stocked for 18 guests, extra towels in the vanities of each bathroom, there is a Kurig AND coffee maker. The pool in the back is a really great size to hold all your guests. I took full advantage of ALL of Jen's suggestions by having a chef come in and cook Dinner on Saturday night, brought in massage therapist that 5 of our guests took advantage of, AND, we took advantage of the pre stocking of the fridge and pantry. Jen was super responsive and accommodating. She also let us have an early check in. All of our family members were very impressed with the house and all the perks. This place is a MUST STAY and I'm SUPER picky, so that says ALOT! **One thing to point out for clarification...there is a full bath in the game room area for the 2 rooms off the game room to use."

reviews.title: A Dream!
reviews.comment: "I had my bachelorette party here and the compound is absolutely beautiful! The rooms were all equally beautiful with of course, the master bedroom being a DREAM. Jen's team was very responsive and all the directions were so easy to follow. You will not regret staying here for any big celebration events you are planning. This home and this team were absolutely amazing!"

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.comment: "Had an incredible week at this property. Amazing outdoor space and suited all of our needs for our 18 guests. Jen was a gracious, friendly and responsive host. Would highly recommend this property for large groups. Absolutely stunning grounds. Would definitely return!"

reviews.title: Like a Resort!
reviews.comment: "We stayed at Base Camp for 4 nights and had a blast! We had at least 1 person in each room and had plenty of space, it did not feel crowded at all. I believe that Parties planning on staying there at maximum occupancy could do so and be very comfortable. The back yard is also very spacious and the pool has plenty of chair and towels and umbrellas — it feels like you’re at a resort pool. The kitchen has all the necessary equipment, flatware, cutlery, etc. (unlike some vacation homes) and the bedrooms have plenty of towels and soaps — all the necessities Would definitely recommend!"

reviews.title: Truly Has it All
reviews.comment: "If you’re looking for a getaway to a place that truly has it all this is it. My wife and I spent three days here while we went to Stagecoach and we always wanted to head home because of how wonderful the house was. The two pools are amazing and the hot tub. We spent most of the time poolside and even had an outdoor fridge stuffed with our favorite adult beverages. We will be back soon! Thanks again Jen for being the best host."

reviews.title: So Much To Offer!
reviews.comment: "Beautiful property that exceeded expectations. Friendly and helpful hosts. Perfect place for a relaxing family getaway. The property has so much to offer there’s no need to go anywhere!"

reviews.title: The Best
reviews.comment: "Best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at!"

reviews.title: Absolutely Fantastic!
reviews.comment: "Jen's place was absolutely fantastic! A group of us went for my bachelorette party, and we enjoyed a few days of hiking and relaxing around the pool. Jen was super easy to communicate with when a few small house-related items needed fixed and they were quickly taken care of. The view was incredible from the house, we enjoyed the privacy and found it to be super relaxing. Would 10/10 recommend and hoping to come back someday!"

reviews.title: Beautiful and well appointed.
reviews.comment: "Outstanding and gorgeous property. Beautiful and well appointed. Wonderful semi private setting. Its exactly as described and photographed.We had a great and fun time with all the outdoor pools and games. The Hammocks are a plus and so is the fire pit and the outdoor BBQ and dining area - so beautiful. Indoors well appointed with subtle, calming, beautiful furnishings and great beds! One very slight issue - need more bath/toilets for the number of bedrooms they have as the present numbers not sufficient in my experience - although I wouldn't hesitate to book again."

reviews.title: Dream Getaway!
reviews.comment: "This is a dream property for any vacation. An absolutely gorgeous home that is spacious, clean, well stocked, well managed, has a great floor plan, great decor, and an amazing location. A few yards from the front gate is Cahuilla Hills Park with great hiking trails and gorgeous views. You are also a 5 minute drive from all of the amenities and shopping you could ever desire. Book it now for a dream get away!"

reviews.title: Definitely Recommend!
reviews.comment: "Our office stayed here for our visioning retreat weekend, and it was perfect for what we needed! The bedrooms were spacious, the kitchen was perfect for hosting our team dinners, and everything was clean and nicely furnished. The outdoor space was an amazing backdrop and perfect for early morning yoga. I definitely recommend this place!"

reviews.title: Beautiful Property!!
reviews.comment: "This is a beautiful property!! It's just as pictured with plenty of space for a large groups. I hope to stay here again in the future and I highly recommend to anyone looking!"

reviews.title: Amazing House
reviews.comment: "Amazing house, beautiful location with the backdrop of the mountains. Well stocked kitchen. Accommodations were perfect for a gathering of friends to celebrate my husband’s 40th birthday!"

reviews.title: Didn't want to leave!
reviews.comment: "Stayed at Basecamp for a long weekend with girlfriends and it was perfect! The pools were clean and beautiful, the house impeccable with plenty of space for us to each have quiet space alone and come together as a group. The views are stunning. The house had everything we needed to cook at home and play during the day. We didn't want to leave! Jen was an amazing, attentive host. We will be back!"

reviews.title: Magical!
reviews.comment: "Our stay at Basecamp was magical! The location is simply stunning-tucked away right against the mountains. The house so comfortable and decor is absolutely beautiful. It is even better in real life than the pictures! The kitchen is a dream- fully stocked with every dish and piece of equipment you need to cook and entertain. The two pools and hot tub are wonderful. We loved every minute of our time there!"

reviews.title: Base Camp - Beautiful Oasis in the Desert
reviews.comment: "Base Camp was the perfect Oasis for our group of 15! From the California chic decor to the many bedrooms, bathrooms, gameroom and beautiful outdoor space, this home had everything we needed and more. The Kitchen was extremely spacious and perfect for several families to work together to prep and enjoy meals. Our group had a great time! This was our first time booking with Travlr Vacation Homes, the team was very accommodating and attentive, we will definitely book with Travlr again!"

reviews.title: Wonderfully quiet and relaxing
reviews.comment: "Perfect place for 12 friends to stay for the weekend. The pool was definitely the highlight. Wonderfully quiet and relaxing. Plenty of space in the kitchen for family style dinners and casual breakfasts. Easy to get to and appreciated the mountain view. Something for everyone. Would recommend this lovely estate for any group of friends or family."

reviews.title: This house was amazing!
reviews.comment: "This house was amazing! Perfect spot for my brother's bachelor party. We didn't even leave the house! Hose is right next to the court, so you can play volleyball even in the heat and then hit the pool to cool down."

reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful spot.
reviews.comment: "Location doesn’t get any better!! Absolutely beautiful spot. We had a quick weekend with family- we realized could have easily brought the little ones, with multiple bunk beds, plenty of games, etc… but it was great to hike the hills, come back a jump in the pool then enjoy a home cooked meal at a table large enough to seat all 12 of us. The bedrooms and bathrooms are just perfect. We will definitely be back when it’s no so hot so we can enjoy more of that beautiful back yard. A “plus plus”!"

reviews.title: Loved Everything
reviews.comment: "Loved everything- the house was a perfect space for a large group, the location is amazing, the checkin was easy, everything was clean and comfortable. Would highly recommend!!"

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.comment: "This house was beautiful and looked exactly like the photos. Jen and her team were wonderful and responsive throughout the whole process. We booked Chef Dave and housekeeping. Everything went very smoothly! I'd love to stay here again!!"

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.comment: This place was amazing must stay and the host was fantastic worth the stay thank u

reviews.title: Top Marks All Around
reviews.comment: "Base Camp is all it is said to be in the other reviews and more! The photos make it look great but don't do it justice because it is all at least as good as it looks in the photos. We all had a brilliant and meaningful time together staying there and would do so again in a heartbeat when visiting Palm Desert again!! Top marks all round!!!"

reviews.title: Incredible home!!!
reviews.comment: "Incredible home!!! I especially loved the hammocks! Every room was so comfortable and made the entire experience 10/10 for every guest that stayed with me. Location was great and all amenities were excellent! There is also target and whole foods less than 5 mins away which made getting supplies incredibly easy! Would highly recommend for any type of event you would want to stay here for! Will def come here again. Thank you so much ♥️"

reviews.title: I highly recommend.
reviews.comment: "I booked this for a company retreat and everything was great. I highly recommend."

reviews.title: ABSOLUTELY STUNNING!
reviews.comment: "This is our second time staying with Jen and we are so happy with this second experience! The house is ABSOLUTELY STUNNING! Location is priceless everything was around the corner, we had a hike so close and you can imagine start day doing hiking and then a splash in those pool! We had a beautiful time that we can get back because is in my top list! Thank you Jen for all your help’"

reviews.title: The best Coachella!
reviews.comment: Very smooth & seamless process from start to finish! The property is exceptionally maintained and centrally located. Will book again!

reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.comment: "We had a great time. The process was easy and the home exceeded expectations."

reviews.title: Our favorite stay yet!
reviews.comment: "Our favorite stay yet! Our group of family & friends had the best time at Base Camp. The home has so much to offer with the open layout, multiple bedrooms and entertaining backyard (pool, hot tub, volleyball, hiking and more!). The house it tucked away from the main roads to feel private and isolated enough to enjoy your stay with shopping, grocery and restaurants less than 10 minutes away. The host was extremely responsive and made us feel welcome during our stay. Everyone felt as if they were at a resort and it was hard to leave. We highly recommend this house and we cannot wait to return!"

reviews.title: Clean, Beautiful Home
reviews.comment: "Jen, was extremely helpful if we had any questions. Clean, beautiful home."

reviews.title: We will rent this again
reviews.comment: "We will rent this again. We celebrated a birthday here and enjoyed every minute. The layout of the house is perfect for a large group and we enjoyed the amenities."

reviews.title: Absolutely Beautiful Home & Property in Every Aspect
reviews.comment: "This is an absolutely beautiful home & property in every aspect. We loved it’s proximity to great hiking trails, secluded, quiet & beautiful views. We look forward to staying at Base Camp again. Highly recommend this property"

reviews.title: Beautiful in Every Way
reviews.comment: "The house is exactly as pictured. Beautiful in every way. Check in and Check out was easy. The management was responsive to all our requests. Each room was more beautiful than the next. The views in the backyard cannot be beat. We felt very secluded. You will see some hikers off in the distance but nothing intrusive and from doing the hike you cannot see much of the house as its covered by a lot of palm trees. Our whole experience was Amazing. One thing I would note. This is not a house of night owls. The house has VERY strict quiet hours at 9pm. The exterior speakers and lights all turn off at curfew. We received nightly texts reminding us to be inside....the fines start at $1,000K if these hours are not met. Ultimately, we just moved the party into the house at night."

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.comment: "We had an incredible time…this house is absolutely gorgeous!! Everything was seamless from the beginning. Great communication. Extremely clean and beautifully decorated. We already want to come stay again!!!"

reviews.title: I had a fantastic stay at Base Camp
reviews.comment: "My old college pals and I had a fantastic stay at Base Camp. The pools were wonderful, the landscaping was lovely, and all of the rooms were very comfortable. Jen, the host, was very responsive and gave very detailed check-in and check-out instructions. We stayed for a week and only left the property to get groceries, hike on the trails, and get date shakes because we enjoyed our time "at camp" so much. No one wanted to leave and we all agreed it was one of the best vacations we've taken in a long time. Pro tip: there are umbrella holders in the shallow "shelf" areas of the pool!"

reviews.title: Highly recommend and would stay again!
reviews.comment: "Beautiful home and the service from Jen and her team was top notch. Highly recommend and would stay again!"

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.comment: "Had an incredible time here with a group of friends for my birthday weekend! Everything was even better than we expected- the home and surrounding views are stunning. Communication was great with TRAVLR throughout our stay as well. I would highly recommend this place to others and would stay here again."

reviews.title: 5 Stars
reviews.comment: "Wonderful stay! Excited to come back."

reviews.title: First Class
reviews.comment: "We had an amazing time and we did family Olympics that were a blast and we couldn't have had such a great time anywhere else. The amenities are awesome and the management and property were first class."

reviews.title: Just as beautiful as the pictures
reviews.comment: "The place was just as beautiful as the pictures. Extremely private. The perfect get away while still being close enough to stores and restaurants if you want."

reviews.title: Base Camp is like an oasis in the desert
reviews.comment: "Base Camp is like an oasis in the desert--isolated enough but also not so far from El Paseo Drive and other important places like grocery stores. Everything is incredibly well-curated and guests will constantly be surprised at all the nice little details. The pools are wonderful (go for the heating if you can outside of the dead of summer) and the activities available are fun to keep the days entertaining. We ran into some unexpected issues with the wind, but this may more be something related to the area and not always something you should expect--we were told that it was worse than usual by some native to the area. Checking in easy, and the place is an absolute dream for entertaining, enjoying the day, and enjoying company. Highly recommended!"

reviews.title: Exceptional Property
reviews.comment: "We absolutely loved our stay at Base camp. The property is more beautiful than the photos and the location is ideal. You are literally steps away from hiking trails in a very serene setting. If you want great restaurants and stores they are a 5-10 minute drive away or a 30 minute walk - really convenient. The house is immaculate, well stocked and the grounds pristine. The support from the management staff was excellent throughout the whole process - from booking to during our stay. This is an exceptional property, we hope to return in the future."

reviews.title: Greatest vacation for the family!
reviews.comment: "Greatest vacation for the family! House is a retreat we could have been anywhere in the world with the views and activities all inclusive. Didn't leave the property in 3 days!!"

reviews.title: As advertised
reviews.comment: "Delivered. As advertised."

reviews.title: Amazing luxury property
reviews.comment: "Amazing luxury property with a great location in Palm Desert and hosts with a very high attention to detail. The property itself is newly remolded with a ton of space and every appliance in there is brand new. The house itself came stocked with all the essentials you would need to be able to enjoy your vacation. There are countless activities to do here such as: 2 pools with views (Heated before our arrival which was a nice touch), full size Volleyball court, tennis court, Bocci ball court, game room with a pool table and ping pong table, hiking trails right outside the backyard, walking distance to shops and restaurants, or simply laying in the 3 hammocks while listening to music with their Sonos sound system that links throughout the entire house. The hosts attention to detail was apparent from the moment you book your stay to the moment you leave. The property was clean and spotless when we arrived and the host was quick to respond with any questions we had (which weren't many) and accommodated any and all special requests. Overall, if you are looking for a luxury vacation experience to book in palm springs / palm desert I would not hesitate with this property and these hosts. We will certainly book this amazing experience again soon."

reviews.title: If there was a crown jewel in the desert, this property would be it!
reviews.comment: "If there was a crown jewel in the desert, this property would be it! Have you been longing for a change of scenery these days? Dreaming of a luxury getaway? Looking to create memories for the books? Wishing you can jump into an architectural digest home? If you answered yes to any of these questions, then this house is for you! The checkin process was easier then any Airbnb I've stayed at and the hosts were very attentive. When we arrived we opened the door to the most breathtaking views of the mountains. The house was spotless. The beds are comfortable, the bathrooms are very nice and the kitchen is fully equipped which I appreciate because I love to cook. The house comes with an easy to read binder for operating instructions, though we didn't really need it. Everything is or looks brand new. The interior decor is beautiful and is giving me major redecorating goals. The common area is very open. It's a perfect spot for entertaining and for kids to play if you decide to be indoors; though I must admit the best part of this house is outside. We had so much fun playing and lounging in the pool, enjoying a game of bocce, hitting the ball around in volleyball court, sitting around the fire pit at night and of course jumping into the beautifully lit up jacuzzi with a cocktail. There was literally not a moment of boredom. The worst part about this house is leaving it!"

reviews.title: Will return again for sure!
reviews.comment: "Incredible property loaded with amenities and built-in activities. Centrally located and access to amazing hiking right from the house. Will return again for sure!"

reviews.title: This property has it all
reviews.comment: "This property has it all. Our family loved the fire pit, pool, close proximity to hiking, shopping and markets. The volleyball court was especially fun. The house came equipped with everything we needed during our stay, was clean and beautifully decorated. The management was available and easy to communicate with. We can’t wait to go back!"

reviews.title: One of the best rentals we've ever had
reviews.comment: "One of the best rentals we've ever had. Beautiful property, and the views from the backyard are just amazing. Looking forward to staying here in the hot summer months!"

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.comment: "Great place, amazing views, very responsive hosts. Highly recommended."

reviews.title: Will 10000% be staying here again!
reviews.comment: "This was the best house I've ever rented! Celebrated my 30th birthday with a group of friends and the house exceeded all of our expectations! Comfortably slept everyone and had something for every person to have a great time. Loved the Sonos sound system being connected all through the house and backyard, and how open the inside of the house was. Backyard is amazing! Felt super private even though there are homes on each side of the property and loved the views/access to hiking trail from the house- had no issues with noise. The house is super easy to figure out and checking in and out was great. Jen and her team were super responsive to any questions we had and made sure we had a great stay! Will 10000% be staying here again!"

reviews.title: 5 Stars
reviews.comment: "Very responsive and helpful staff!"

reviews.title: Would highly recommend
reviews.comment: "Well equipped, comfortable rental. Great with a large group. Plenty of space and tons of amenities! Would highly recommend."

reviews.title: Everything & more than we could have asked for
reviews.comment: "This stay was perfect for 15 of our closest friends and family. Even better than expected. would definitely recommend this to anyone. We didn't want to leave! Took advantage of the concierge service / pre-stocking which was a game changer. Base Camp was everything & more than we could have asked for."

reviews.title: Would love to go back.
reviews.comment: "We had a great time at this property. We were a group of 12 ranging from 10-70 yrs old and the house was perfect for all ages. We loved the pools, the volleyball court, bocce and ping pong. The tween kids loved having their own private space (the converted garage). House was super clean and everything worked great. There are several great hiking trails you can access from the backyard so that was very fun. Tons of bedrooms. Jen The property manager and her team were amazing and super responsive. Was a great getaway and we would love to go back."

reviews.title: Location can't be beat!
reviews.comment: "Very accurate listing. Clean, beautiful view and very easy clear communication with management. Location can’t be beat! Perfect house for a low key getaway with friends and family."

reviews.title: Would highly recommend
reviews.comment: "Property is as beautiful in real life as the advertised pics. Great entertainment area around the pool, competition standard beach volleyball court, plenty of daybeds and umbrellas were nice for some shade. All the rooms were terrific and clean. Great entertainment space in the living room + kitchen. Would highly recommend."

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.comment: "This place is absolutely amazing. My family and I were beyond amazed of how spacious, beautiful and private Base Camp was. Highly recommend and will definitely be staying here again."

reviews.title: Amazing property
reviews.comment: "Amazing property with gorgeous views!"

reviews.title: Absolutely phenomenal.
reviews.comment: "Absolutely phenomenal."

reviews.title: Truly Unforgettable
reviews.comment: "Base Camp is truly the ideal luxury vacation home for high-end living, with hiking trails, amazing mountain views, tennis, swimming and more! The newly renovated property is fit for the most discriminating vacationers and will exceed all expectations for luxury, star gazing and comfort. The best shopping in the desert is situated only blocks away where we found high-end boutiques and the best food options. My family enjoyed ordering Mastro’s takeout. We felt like royalty sitting poolside at a new dining table watching a stunning sunset with the mountain backdrop. This home has two private pools that offered unobstructed views of the city lights and the mountains in front and in back. We roasted s’mores by the fire pit and took advantage of the sand volley ball court and bocce ball court. The TRAVLR property management team offered immediate response to any of our questions, and our stay at Base Camp will be remembered forever. Base Camp is truly a unique property that sets the stage for the perfect desert experience for family and friends to enjoy!"

reviews.title: Exceeded our Expectations
reviews.comment: "This property exceeded our expectations. Definitely one of the most well maintained properties we have stayed at, and we rent VRBO's quite frequently. The two salt water pools were extremely relaxing, as the higher density water allows you to float effortlessly. Only complaint would be that the two volleyballs that came with the house were deflated, but we bought a hand pump from a nearby sporting goods store and were good to go. We are looking forward to returning soon."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "This house was great for the 5 days we were there, the only drawback was the amount of bathrooms vs how many bedrooms. Overall the house was beautiful and we had a wonderful time!"

reviews.title: Phenomenal!
reviews.comment: "This house is honestly phenomenal! The house was very clean and spacious. The host was available 24/7 ... The property sits on the mountains which had amazing views and it’s on a private road which was awesome. The house did have two amazing pools. They don’t have a patio for the backyard but from talking to the host, I was told there should be one in the future. There are neighbors in the mountains so definitely keep the volume low with the sound ordinance in effect for the area. I definitely give this house five stars! Can’t wait for the next stay!"

reviews.title: Best in the Desert
reviews.comment: "We absolutely loved our stay at this beautiful home! The home is in pristine condition and the details that Jen incorporated into the remodel were designed to create the perfect luxury rental home experience. The views were incredible, and we enjoyed swimming in both the backyard and front pool, which were both extremely clean and well maintained. Base Camp is centrally located in Palm Desert and is right next to the shops at El Paseo, also right at the base of several well-known hiking and biking trails. Swimming in the pool at sunset watching the sun set behind the mountains was an unforgettable experience and we felt like we had the whole desert to ourselves. The guest services team at TRAVLR Vacation Homes exceeded all of our expectations and were very responsive throughout our entire stay. This truly is one of the most unique and amazing properties in the desert."

reviews.title: Location Location Location
reviews.comment: 'My family had a great experience staying with TRAVLR Vacation Homes. We have stayed at several of their desert properties in the past, and their new Base Camp property in Palm Desert steps into a whole new class of vacation rental properties. The house is incredibly clean, everything is brand new, there are 2 pools with outstanding views of the mountains, and it is located just down the street from El Paseo. The location couldn’t get any better. We love this new property and will definitely be staying here again!"

reviews.title: STUNNING
reviews.comment: "Wow, this place really exceeded every expectation I had. First the home is STUNNING and so aesthetically pleasing. Plenty of room both indoors and outdoors creating many activities and memories for my 14 person family. Every bed was huge, tons of dinnerware, utensils, cups, pots, pans, towels, soap, you name it. Everything in the house from design to functionality was so well thought out. The pictures accurately represent the space, but the views of the mountains and backyard landscape are indescribable. I cannot express how pleasant my trip was. Jen was also so easy to get a hold of and resolved any simple issue or question I had. I really have post-vacation blues today. There is so much more I can say, but this review would be too long. Everyone should experience Base Camp. We will definitely be coming back next year."

reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.comment: "Amazing stay in Palm Desert with close family friends and kids ages 11-15. When at the property -- a true oasis. Unique, secluded location right up against the foothills with beautiful views, great hiking trials and lots of indoor/outdoor space and activities to enjoy. Well appointed kitchen with all the amenities. At the same time, a 5 minute drive to great dining, shopping and everything one would need. Property manager was very communicative and checked in several times during our stay. We could not recommend Base Camp more highly, and look forward to our next stay."

reviews.title: 10 stars!
reviews.comment: "What an incredible property with an owner that ensures you have a great vacation. I wish I could give it more stars."

reviews.title: Outstanding!
reviews.comment: “Base Camp was an outstanding place to visit. The property is large and lends itself to a perfect mix of relaxation and enjoyment. The location is perfect, nestled up against the hills, it feels isolated yet is somehow only minutes from town. The backyard is extremely well equipped - sizable pool, hot tub, bocce ball court, volleyball court, tons of chairs/sofas to lounge on, bbq, fire pit etc. The interior is nicely redone and felt very clean, bright and open. Perfect for a multiple family trip, or multiple couples retreat. We'd definitely consider coming back.”

reviews.title: President & Owner
reviews.comment: Really Special Location and Awesome Accommodations! Perfect Desert House for Active Family with Teens and College Age Kids. Wonderful backyard and pool setup. Extremely attentive owner and management. Would stay again at Base Camp in Palm Desert in a heart beat.

reviews.comment: "I just wanted to say I had the absolute BEST time at your new Base Camp property! Thank you so much for recommending it. It had everything we needed and couldn’t have been more perfect. My parents loved how private it was and spent all night in the backyard soaking in that incredible mountain view. We can’t wait to return next year. I can’t thank you enough!"

reviews.title: Can't Wait to Return!
reviews.comment: "Our stay at Cappella was outstanding from start to finish. The home itself is beautiful, exceptionally clean, well-equipped, and exactly as advertised. The backyard is incredible, with the pool, spa, outdoor living space, and golf course views making it hard to leave. What really set this stay apart, though, was the team at Travlr. We had a handful of questions before and during our trip, and every time we reached out, their customer support team responded almost immediately. Everyone we interacted with was friendly, professional, and genuinely focused on making sure we had a great experience. It’s rare to find a vacation rental company that’s this attentive after you’ve checked in, and it made a noticeable difference throughout our stay. It’s clear that Travlr cares about both the quality of their homes and the experience of their guests. We wouldn’t hesitate to book with them again and would happily recommend both Cappella and Travlr to anyone planning a trip to La Quinta."

We will be talking about this home for years to come, and will definitely book again! Thank you for such a memorable weekend!"

reviews.title: Terrific Property!
reviews.comment: "Enjoyed every second on this beautiful property! House is terrific! Spacious and so well decorated! Highly recommend!"

reviews.title: Look forward to returning!
reviews.comment: "We greatly enjoyed our stay at Capella in La Quinta. This gorgeous home had a great Mediterranean vibe with richly appointed furnishings and a kitchen outfitted for a chef. The expansive open rooms and indoor/outdoor layouts accommodated the entertainment needs of 4 couples in town for golf, great weather and the celebration of a birthday. The bedrooms each had their own bathrooms, a plus we all noted. We made daily use of the pool/spa, fire pit and outdoor balcony overlooking the golf course and the Valley. Most importantly, there were plenty of places to gather for food, wine and card games. We look forward to a future return!"

reviews.title: Loved!
reviews.comment: "Our family if 8 loved our stay! Would stay here again!!!"

reviews.title: Looking forward to returning!
reviews.comment: "We had a group of 9 that stayed in this beautiful home in Feb 2024 and everything was as shown in the pictures plus more! The house is layed out nicely that everyone had their own space and privacy along with multiple seating areas inside and outside. The pool and hot tub were clean and very easy to operate. Along with the fire pit, outdoor kitchen, putting green, loungers and sitting areas, spending time outside was great. The house is stocked with all the essentials, but don’t expect left over condiments, lotions, pool toys etc, but after Covid this seems like a smart approach from the hosts. The Sonos sound system is throughout the house and easy to operate on the app. Response from the host was quick and courteous with any questions we had. Looking forward to returning!"

reviews.title: Great Family Stay
reviews.comment: "We had a great stay with family. The home was in a great neighborhood, very safe and quiet, and the home offered a lot of things for us to do when we were not playing golf. The owners also allowed us to bring our dog, and he was happy to be included. The beds were very comfortable as well. We would definitely like to stay here again, and we would recommend this home to anyone else inquiring about renting. Thank you for being great hosts who were prompt to reply to any of our questions from the time we listed and during our stay. 5 Stars well deserved!"

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.comment: "We had 2 families (4 adults, 4 children) spend a long weekend at this house. The house was extremely clean, the property manager was very prompt and helpful. The house is stunning and so were all of the outdoor spaces. This is our 3rd trip to La Quinta and this was by far our favorite property. We would definitely love to return to this property in the future!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Gorgeous Home and Wonderful Communication"

reviews.title: By Far The Best
reviews.comment: "We absolutely loved our time at this property! There are 8 of us that do a long weekend in the area every year, and this is by far the best place we’ve been to. Everything feels like luxury and there are a million cozy places to relax outside and inside the house. The space is so clean, well considered, and comfortable. We really hope to be back."

reviews.title: Perfect, Private & Safe
reviews.comment: "We loved Jen’s house! Rented the place for a weekend for a friends b day. All she wanted to do was her some sun, relax, and recharge. This was place perfect. Giant property, very private and safe, easy to get to, and fully equipped! She was super responsive and always willing to help. We requested early check in and they made it happen. They also welcomes our service dog without issue. The only issue we had was with the temperature in the master suite (couldn’t figure out which thermostat was the correct one) but wasn’t a huge deal as it was kept pretty cool. All in all, can’t wait to head back and enjoy more sun in the desert!"

reviews.title: Very Nicely Appointed
reviews.comment: "Our family had an amazing time celebrating our daughter’s birthday at this lovely home. It was beautiful and we really enjoyed all of the amenities. We had a local chef come in to prepare dinner for our group. I needed a florist and Jen immediately sent a couple referrals- the flowers turned out gorgeous. Home was very nicely appointed. We will definitely be back!"

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.comment: "Our stay at Cappella was awesome. We were 2 families, 9 people total. The home was spacious enough to give everyone the privacy they wanted but the common areas, both indoors and outdoors, were great for entertaining. Keeping this home clean and functional would seem like a daunting task, but the property managers do an awesome job. There are a lot of "moving parts" in this house and Travlr obviously runs a tight ship. The house and property were clean. The bedrooms were spacious and very comfortable. Communication with Travlr was easy. I would highly recommend this company and specifically this home."

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.comment: "Great place to stay at and pool and house was amazing"

reviews.title: We loved it!!!
reviews.comment: "Jen was super quick on responding, the place was beautiful and just as the pictures. Our family really felt at home. The plan of our trip was to relax and disconnect from the world . This place sure helped us with it!!! We loved it!!! Definitely come back again!!"

reviews.title: This place was amazing!
reviews.comment: "This place was amazing! I honestly wished we would have booked it longer. We hung out by the pool all day, cooked dinner over the grill and had a nice time relaxing and taking in the beautiful scenery. Every room was equipped with its own bathroom and own tv- so lots of privacy there. Would love to stay again. I had a few questions and I was always able to get them resolved quickly."

reviews.title: SO Lovely!
reviews.comment: "Home was soo lovely we all want to come back. Enjoyed pool, hot-tub, put-put, outdoor kitchen and the many lovely interior areas for catching up. Everyone told me how comfortable their beds were. Highly recommend!"

reviews.title: Absolutely Breathtaking
reviews.comment: "Our group loves traveling, has been all over the world, and stayed in some of the most beautiful places. That being said, we were all in complete awe of the home. It is stunning in the photos but absolutely breathtaking in person. It has extremely high ceilings, is decorated perfectly, and extremely spacious. I can't believe how immaculately clean every inch of the home was, especially the kitchen. It was so well stocked with anything and everything you could possibly need. The wet bar has an ice maker and a water filtration system which made our lives so much easier. The sound system in the house was impressive (we are all music junkies). Each room was in its own section, had its own bathroom, and a king size bed, which offered so much privacy. We spent a lot more time in the home than we thought we would because it actually felt like home. The best part though was the backyard with the view. We felt like we were in nature without having to actually deal with nature lol and watching the sunsets was magical. Management was quick to respond to anything we needed and helped with recommendations for nearby restaurants... although we couldn't get ourselves to leave the home. Thank you for creating the perfect environment and thinking of every single detail to help make our stay perfect. We are all very appreciative."

reviews.title: Highly Recommended
reviews.comment: “I cannot recommend Casa Agave highly enough. We had a multigenerational family gathering there; and every category of person (from grandparents to kids and everyone in between) had a terrific time. The home is so tastefully decorated, so clean, and lives up to the photos. In fact, I think it is difficult to capture the beauty of the view in photography -- you need to stay here to really appreciate it (assuming you like desert views and golf course green). The other aspect that I did not fully appreciate from the listing is how much privacy each bedroom has, given the layout of the home. Finally, there are some amazing desert hikes and runs a short drive away. If you like the desert landscape, this is the place for you. You will not regret your decision to book this property! A few tips to keep in mind: 1. If you like to cook, this is a great home for you. However, there is no garlic press on site. Also, the nearest organic foods grocery store is a Whole Foods that is about 30 minutes away. Plan a big single shop and you'll be set! 2. Two of the bedrooms are in a separate casita with secure locking door. We had planned on this space for our kids, and luckily we have a responsible 10 year old in the mix who can follow simple steps for the pushbutton lock. The (unlocked) door from the street into the inner courtyard is right near this casita door, and they need to open a separate pushbutton lock to enter the main house, so if your kids are too young to be trusted to lock themselves in at night; or to know how to open locked doors in case of emergency, it might be tricky to have them stay in the casita. Again, it worked for us, but something to keep in mind.”

reviews.title: Wonderful Place. Amazing Views.
reviews.comment:
"Casa Agave is such a wonderful place, it’s hard to know where to begin. It starts when you walk in the front door looking straight back to an amazing view of the Greg Norman PGA West golf course framed by the Santa Rosa mountains. We loved sitting outside watching the sun change the look of the mountains throughout the day. The view makes this rental one of the best. You barely see any other houses; it is so private. Add the putting green, outdoor marble ping pong table, fire pit and of course the pool and spa and you have heaven on earth. Another great amenity is the dog door leading into a fenced courtyard making it much easier to bring our dogs.



When you return to the inside, you immediately feel at home. The furniture is comfortable, the decor relaxing and most importantly the bed was comfortable. I love that there are five king beds being able to easily accommodate five couples and then some.



As for bedrooms, one casita bedroom and the master bedroom have their own Keurig Coffee machine so you can relax with your coffee before joining the group. I also love that most of the bedrooms have a chair so you can relax in privacy. An added bonus in each bedroom is a three USB port charger. The master bathroom is divine with a deep soaker tub, large walk-in shower and a huge closet, big enough to let a baby sleep.



Speaking of babies, there is a port-a-crib, a stroller and a removable fence to block off the pool so you can feel secure your child will be safe.



The kitchen is well equipped (see the website to see what is included) which I appreciate since I like to cook instead of going out for all our meals. It is well stocked with spices which saves time and makes planning meals much easier.



The pool table and work out room are an added bonus. It would be a perfect house to host a large group. I can’t think of anything this house doesn’t offer. We wished we had stayed longer.



Finally, I was very impressed by TRAVLR. They were available to answer questions and help in any way necessary. They are a top-notch vacation rental management company."

reviews.comment: “I stayed at Casa Agave with my family and was blown away by our experience. I chose this home because the style was so unique and it had all of the amenities on our list - including a gym which we used every day! The attention to detail was impeccable - you can really tell that the homeowner and TRAVLR Vacation Homes really care about the home and our experience as guests. I will definitely be coming back! reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.comment: "We booked Casa De Sol for my son's 14th birthday. We had a couple of relatives and some child friends come with us so I was concerned about having ample space. Due to COVID-19 restrictions for most of May and June and things easing up, I waited a little too long to book places in the $600-700 range which quickly booked up. After researching more expensive home I found Casa De Sol, and this place did not disappoint!! Arrangements were made through the management company Travelr. They were amazing to communicate with prior to, during, and after our stay. The management host Alexa was great and made sure our arrival was successful. They have a texting feature which is great and they are very responsive (and friendly). The property is located in a gated community overlooking the green on the private Nicklaus PGA West Course. Getting in and out of the gated community is no problem, just dont forget your pass. What makes this property unique (and great for a vacation rental) is how the home is situated. While many properties have small back yards with pools facing the golf course, this home is located on a large corner lot with the pool located in a private side courtyard. The back yard with it's covered veranda features a nice private cove feel with rolling lawn, fire pit seating area, space for the kids and dogs to play, views of the green, ping pong table, couches, and plenty of privacy. The pool is located just off the kitchen and great room and is surrounded by beautiful palm trees, a large wall with a golf cart path in between houses and the detached Casita. The trees and umbrellas offer nice options for shade during hot days. We positioned all 3 umbrellas over the pool baja shelf. I put a chair in the pool under the umbrella and sat there all day watching the young ones swim. The pool is maybe 5.5' deep on the far end and plenty big enough for several kids to swim in. The raised spa is very nice and adds a nice waterfall feature, though it was too hot outside for us to really enjoy. With the positioning of the pool and courtyard, it adds a nice layer of sound protection so you aren't really concerned with noise, privacy with golfers, or bothering neighbors. Its 100% private. Being in the real estate profession myself, I see a lot of homes. I have to say this floor plan is one of the best I've seen. The great room is simply incredible with 20ft soaring ceilings which also flow into the master bedroom. The furniture is beautiful and very comfortable. The 75" new Samsung TV is great for watching movies and their were TV's in every bedroom. The kitchen is very functional and recently remodeled. There is a huge pantry plus an additional wine and beverage fridge which got put to good use. I believed prior to arrival they dumped all of the ice from the previous tenant due to COVID. They offered to bring us some but we had already left to the store, so no big deal and the ice maker was working within hours. Due to COVID we cooked all of our meals except for one night when we ordered pizza. The outdoor BBQ is very good as well as all of the cooking appliances. The kitchen is well appointed with everything you need including plateware and plastic options. For families with older kids, this house is a MUST STAY! The detached Casita has 4 full size bunks for the teenagers. It also includes a small kitchenette, and separate bedroom/bath. We had 4 boys in there and they were able to hook up their Xbox and Nintendo. At night they would disappear in there which made evenings more relaxing for the adults. The Casita is a HUGE plus and can house a family of 6. We only had a total of 9 people but if you booked the limit of 14 there would still be plenty of room for everyone. The master suite is amazing as well. The bathroom must be 300 sq ft! There is a sitting area and large walk-in closet. The master bed is firm which I am not used too, but still comfortable enough. All the linens were white and felt luxurious. They supplied small body wash soap, shampoo, and conditioner bottles in all bathrooms. The only bedroom not en-suite is the office bedroom with queen bed off of the living room. There is a hall bath across living room that has a shower for this bedroom. Small inconvenience, but our guest loved that room regardless because she used the desk to work during the day. Both that room and the master have sliding doors to the patio that faces the golf course. All bedrooms also have plantation shutters which help with the heat. A/C was ice cold all day every day and the interior temperature was excellent. As far as local amenities, there is plenty of excellent golf options nearby. We played La Qunita - Mountain course which was a 15 minute drive away. PGA West and SilverRock are minutes away. There is a Ralph's Grocery about 5 miles away from the house and Costco about 10 minutes from the house. In the evening the kids played on the golf course and it was nice to go on walks. At the time of stay the golf course was closed to reconstruction of the green so wasn't concerned about interrupting play. There is a nice 4 hole loop around the community right from the back door which was about a 20 minute walk. We loved that the house was pet friendly! The $150 per pet was a little steep with 2 dogs but worth it in the end. We brought a small older Yorkie and a medium sized terrier mix and never had an issue."

reviews.title: Terrific experience
reviews.comment: "Terrific experience. The house is amazing and the management team that coordinates everything is extremely friendly and responsive. Will definitely come back, thank you!"

reviews.title: Perfect Family Getaway!
reviews.comment: "I felt compelled to leave a review about our stay, we had the most incredible time and the home was absolutely gorgeous. My family loved it! The kids exhausted themselves with all that grass to run around in and they were in and out of the pool all day. We ended up having a heated ping pong tournament at one point, it was hilarious. And perfect. Exactly what we needed. We will definitely be returning in the fall. Thank you for all of your assistance and for being amazing hosts!"

reviews.title: Exceptional Home! Exceptional Service!
reviews.comment: "Our stay at Casa Del Sol was exceptional. The villa is exactly as described and is completely new with great touches and finishes. Luxury at its best! The location was also very convenient and peaceful. Really hope to be back again and stay at this property. The TRAVLR Vacation Homes team was also very helpful and responded immediately whenever we needed something. The service was as expected and totally corresponds to high level of the villa."
