reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.comment: "The house was clean and well equipped for a few days stay. We enjoyed the peaceful surroundings."

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.comment: "We visited this place to play golf at the Pete Dye Stadium Course, and everything was perfect. The clubhouse was only a 2-minute drive away, the house was clean, and all the amenities were high-quality and well-organized. We plan to visit again next year."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Communication with the Travlr team was great! They were very responsive to questions I had. The house was beautiful! Everything seemed new. Just as pictured in the photosLocation was convenient was perfect for what we needed!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Beautiful, thoughtfully designed space in a quiet private community. Comfortable, well-appointed, and immaculately kept — perfect for a relaxing stay. Highly recommend Jen’s place."

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay!
reviews.comment: "We could not have had a better stay at Casa Luna. The house was perfect for us. The kitchen and living/dining room are all together which made it easy for us to cook, talk to everyone and watch all of the games on the big tv. We enjoy cooking and the kitchen has a huge island which made it easy and convenient. The house was well stocked with everything you might need and is beautifully decorated. Beds were comfortable. The team at Travlr was very communicative and helpful, and checked in with us along the way to make sure we were happy during our stay. We had a small issue with the fire table outside and they were very quick to resolve it. The location was lovely in a gated community in PGA West so we could walk to the golf course and restaurant. I would highly recommend this property as well as this company. We will definitely be back!"

reviews.title: Lovely Stay!
reviews.comment: "Great, quiet neighborhood. High ceilings and big windows/doors in the living area made it feel expansive and luxurious. Beds and living room furniture were very comfortable. Everything felt fresh and new. Beautiful home!"

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.comment: "Beautiful home, everything is so nice!! Gorgeous walking areas, quiet streets and gated community. Host was easy to communicate with. The location is a bit of a drive to most amenities, but definitely worth it. The home is really 10/10!"

reviews.title: LOVED this house!
reviews.comment: "Casa Luna felt like an escape from reality. Each room had its own bathroom which was very nice. The third bedroom is detached from the house and gave tons of privacy for our guest in that room. If you are utilizing it for kids it might not be best. Kitchen was beautiful. Neighborhood was amazing. There was a private gate and it was easy to get in and out. Our host Jen was very responsive and helpful. Ultimately a great stay!"

reviews.title: Highly Recommend!
reviews.comment: "Amazing rental! It is so unique to have 3 bedrooms each with King beds and each with full bathrooms. The layout of the house was great and very comfortable. We stayed in and cooked dinner every night in a very impressive kitchen. It had all of the tools needed to cook anything we wanted. The pool was fantastic. Our 3 year old loved playing in the 1 foot deep shallow square area. Perfect! I recommend this property 1000%."

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.comment: "We stayed here to attend a wedding in La Quinta and it was great! The kitchen/dining/living space was perfect for our family to enjoy time together. The kitchen was fully equipped with anything we needed. The Baja step area of the pool was fun and safe for the toddlers in our group. Also loved that the 3 bedrooms had their own bathrooms."

reviews.title: Well Equipped
reviews.comment: "Overall, I felt the home was very well equipped, beds were very comfortable, master bedroom was quite spacious, the Casita was great."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "great location, great home, great communication with Travlr"

reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.comment: "Host was super responsive and answered any and all questions we had! My clients loved the property and we will definitely be back next year. Beautiful place to stay if you are visiting the Palm Spring area. 10/10 recommend!"

reviews.title: Beautiful!!
reviews.comment: "This house was beautiful!! Very well decorated with beautiful courtyard and pool. Open concept with glass door wall leading to pool and jacuzzi. Very clean and really quiet. We loved the fire pit and patio furniture was very comfortable. Kitchen was nicely stocked. Could have used more towels and washcloths, but we located a stash in a drawer before we left in the Casita. Overall, we loved the place, its location and our host Jen who answered all our questions promptly. Would definitely stay here again as the PGA West location in LaQuinta is scenic, quiet and just beautiful!!!"

reviews.title: Exceeded All Expectations!
reviews.comment: "A Perfect Stay" We had an absolutely incredible experience at this Airbnb! From the moment we arrived, we felt welcomed! The host went above and beyond with thoughtful touches. The space itself was stunning—beautifully decorated, spotless, and equipped with everything we could possibly need. The location was ideal! We walked to PGA West for golf and ate at Ernie's Bar & Grill everyday during our stay. What truly set this stay apart was the little things. The beds were so comfortable, and the linens and towels felt luxurious. The kitchen was stocked with quality essentials. Everything was very well thought out and it felt like a brand new home! Super private, very beautiful and just AMAZING! We loved the huge open space for entertaining and the all en-suite bedrooms so no one had to share a bathroom! We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The host was super responsive and attentive to any questions I had. We can't wait to return! Thanks!

reviews.title: Great Family Stay
reviews.comment: "Enjoyed staying here with my family. We all loved the pool and the hot tub it was the perfect weather to splash around. Anything we needed was nearby."

reviews.title: Great Location!
reviews.comment: "Super cozy, perfect for our business trip, conveniently located and beautiful interior design!"

reviews.title: Beautiful Home!
reviews.comment: "The house was beautiful, and comfortable, and our stay was wonderful!! I would absolutely stay there again!!"

reviews.title: Well Appointed!
reviews.comment: "One of the better airbnbs we’ve stayed at. Well designed, great little pool and spa. The pool had a nice very shallow beach area that was great for our 2 year old. Kitchen was well appointed. Comms were great. Beds were comfortable. Home lacked some privacy and was very close to neighboring homes. Things were quiet and we weren’t disturbed but would have been nice to have a little more space. Would not be good for a group of young friends who wanted music and pool party vibes, but that wasn’t what we were there for. Not walkable but a short drive away from a few spots in La Quinta. Price was high, especially the extra charge the for the heated pool. It was still a bit chilly, so we used the hot tub for most of the time and didn’t get much value from the heated pool so slight ding on the rating for value. Overall an experience we’d do again! Way more was right than wrong, I just try to give genuine pros/cons in every review."

reviews.title: Well Appointed
reviews.comment: "My wife and i stayed in this wonderful new house in PGA West. If was very well appointed, we didn't lack for anything. Loved the private pool."

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.comment: "The house is beautiful!"

reviews.title: Best Experience!
reviews.comment: "The best airbnb experience in my past 5 years traveling. Will definitely come back and rent again."

reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.comment: "This house was absolutely amazing . It was So nice using the Hot tub & Fire pit . The layout was so spacious we loved the panel sliders leading out to pool . It was So fun entertaining & hosting our guests. The house literally had Everything we needed . I can’t say enough about it. We loved the furnishings & high end bedding. We didn’t want to leave . Can’t wait to go back !!"

reviews.title: Thanksgiving Getaway!
reviews.comment: "I must say, I did love this house on Champions Way. I think it was much more beautiful than the photos displayed. It was new, comfortable and super clean! The fabric furniture was spotless...that's a big deal to me! The layout was fabulous with an open floor plan and cozy bedrooms. Although we didn't cook much, all appliances were there. I love that there were enough pillows and soft blankets...just the extras that many rental houses don't have. I frequently rent a house for our family get togethers and this was really one of the easiest, most comfortable places we've stayed. Thanks Jenn and TRAVLR, for a great Thanksgiving weekend."

reviews.title: Gorgeous & Incredibly Clean
reviews.comment: "Loved this place so much! I felt at home. The house is gorgeous and something really important to me, it is spotless, incredibly clean. Kitchen has everything and more. Plenty of bathroom and pool towels. It is just a zen place you can kick back and relax! I will definitely stay here again."

reviews.title: Perfect in Every Way
reviews.comment: "5-star place. Very clean and spacious. We liked that the pool was just a few steps from the living room and all bedrooms. The large windows made the place bright. Super large kitchen with terrific island. Really had no complaints about this place. Perfect in every way."

reviews.title: Clean, Bright & Private
reviews.comment: "Casa Luna was even more beautiful than the photos - clean, bright, open and private. It had a wonderful, stocked kitchen, clean bathrooms and comfortable beds. There was more than enough space inside and out for all seven of us. There were great areas to relax and talk, and the outdoor space had everything you need - pool, spa and fire pit with lots of seating and lounges. Would stay here again in a heartbeat, and would definitely recommend it to others."

reviews.title: 5 Stars
reviews.comment: "The house was very clean and the beds were amazing. Jen was so kind, helpful and quick."

reviews.title: Exactly as Advertised!
reviews.comment: "House and pictures were exactly what you saw. Jen is a great communicator and makes for the place to be an amazing rental. Highly recommend for anyone"

reviews.title: Stunning Home!!
reviews.comment: "This home was stunning and even better than in the photos! It is a real gem and I felt so comfortable being in such a beautifully decorated home during our stay. When you open the front door to the courtyard you are stunned at the serene space and it's beauty. This house is in pristine condition and squeaky clean. Jen was always in contact with me within minutes of me texting her and asking her questions and has terrific customer service. Thank you for hosting such a lovely property, we will be back."

reviews.title: The perfect house!
reviews.comment: "The perfect house! It’s basically brand new and spotless. Super clean and we loved the casita. The pool and jacuzzi were great and the kitchen was perfect for cooking! Jen was super responsive and accommodating leading up to our stay! Would highly recommend. Cannot wait to come back!"

reviews.title: Thoughtfully Designed
reviews.comment: "Salt water pool! Lights up nicely at night. Layout is thoughtfully designed. The home feels brand new, and decorated professionally. Having a casita (with its own bath) could be ideal for a lot of groups. The kitchen is well stocked with serving-ware. Exceptionally clean. Would come back."

reviews.title: We had a great time!

reviews.title: The place was absolutely stunning
reviews.comment: "This place was absolutely stunning and perfect for our family getaway. Jen was extremely responsive and was such a great host. We will definitely be returning for future vacations!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: The house was amazing! We were impressed as soon as we walked in. The house looks exactly like the pictures and all of the products and decor were high-quality. The layout of the house is perfect for a 3 groups with each bedroom having its own bathroom. Also, one of the bedrooms is slightly separated from the main house for additional privacy. All of the amenities included with the house took the experience to another level. Also, the host was very responsive whenever I had questions. Location-wise, it is not near many restaurants and activity, however, there are grocery stores within 5 minutes of the house. The area mostly consists of golf courses. We would definitely stay again if we go back to Palm Springs.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.comment: "Jen was quick to respond and incredibly helpful with all of our questions. The photos don’t do this place justice! My family and friends all loved the house. It was clean, well-maintained, and had everything we needed for a great stay. We were also pleasantly surprised with a welcome gift of Crumbl cookies! If you’re looking for a relaxing desert getaway, this is the place to stay. Highly recommend!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Amazing stay with an incredible vibe. Perfect spot for our group golf trip, and the lazy river was the cherry on top. Communication was excellent throughout. Already planning our next visit."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "This is our 3rd year staying at this house Casa Mara. It is nice and clean has all you need. We never left the house. Had a great family vacation so many great memories we have made there. I hope we can return there next year."

reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.comment: "Stayed here for a big family weekend getaway and it was great! There was plenty of space for our group — the older teenagers loved the separate casita while the younger kids enjoyed the bunk bed room. And everyone was comfortable hanging in the open floor plan's communal spaces. The kitchen was fully stocked with every amenity we needed; there were plenty of towels and toiletries for everyone; and the backyard truly felt like a resort with the lazy river/slide, various hammocks and hangout areas, pickleball court and beach volleyball court. There were no issues with the A/C and it kept us cool inside during the hot June desert weather. Jen was a gracious, welcoming host, who kindly answered any questions promptly and professionally. Our entire family loved this vacation home and had a wonderful experience — looking forward to staying here again!"

reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.comment: "What a beautiful property!!! We had the BEST TIME with the whole family together in one house. We will definitely do this again. Thanks so much."

reviews.title: Nice Stay

reviews.title: Amazing home
reviews.comment: "Had 4 families stay there with plenty of space. House was exactly as advertised. We will be staying there again. Enough room and things to do for all ages."

reviews.title: Absolutely Loved!
reviews.comment: "Best desert vacation home there is!!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Casa Mara was the perfect spot to accommodate our business partners who were in Palm Springs for a conference. We’ve stayed in a few large homes in the area and everyone agreed this one was the best. It was roomy enough for everyone to spread out and get some privacy, but there are lots of areas for everyone to gather. The pool and backyard are fantastic and the game room is pretty sweet. We’d book Casa Mara again, no question!"

reviews.title: Great
reviews.comment: "House was perfect. Just as advertised."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Awesome place. Highly recommended"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Casa Mara was definitely one of the best houses my friends and I have ever stayed in. The house was so spacious and clean, with a kitchen stocked with plenty of dishware and cookware for my friends and I to cook delicious meals together :) The location of the house was only 10-15 minutes away from the golf courses we were planning on playing, and there were plenty of supermarkets and grocery stores nearby to have enough food during our stay. The beds were very comfortable, and it was such a lovely property- the private pickleball court was really fun, and we loved the pool and hot tub as well. The host was also gracious enough to not only let us check in a couple hours early, but also extended our check out time a couple more hours, which really helped us with our flight schedule! I highly recommend this property and would love to stay at this beautiful home again :)"

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.comment: "Our daughters and grand kids aged 6 to 13 had a wonderful time at this place. We are thinking of going there a few more times next year. The kids loved the place."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Property and communication was even better than advertised. 10/10"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "We had a group of our kids, their spouses and all our grandkids. This is an annual event for us and out of all the other beautiful homes we’ve stayed in this one got 2 thumbs up from everyone! The bedrooms/bathrooms were nicely decorated, the kitchen was well equipped and spacious. The backyard was absolutely amazing!! The pool was just as beautiful as advertised. The kids loved the slide and the adults loved the spa. We spent one evening in the play room having fun with all the table games, and we even played pickle ball. We will be looking into this same property next year!"

reviews.title: 5 stars all around
reviews.comment: "What a great rental. Not only was the property incredible, the property management was equally as amazing. We didn't have any issues while we stayed, but they made sure we knew they were available and went above and beyond to make sure we felt welcome from the second we walked in the door. I very much much appreciate (and honestly expect) this level of service for a high end rental. -This getaway was for a business retreat, but I'll be back with my family."

reviews.title: Great Family Trip
reviews.comment: "Great place to spend family gatherings"

reviews.title: Something for Everyone
reviews.comment: "Casa Mara is a beautiful property, it is maintained well and is extremely clean. Jen and her team are extremely responsive and accommodating. The property is also loaded with amenities, such as cribs and highchairs. There are an abundant amount of activities to do for all ages, including the pool/lazy river, pickleball courts, volleyball etc.. The Game room attached to the Casita building is also large and has air hockey tables, exercise equipment etc.. The main house, the casita and the game room have great AC, we visited when temperatures were in triple digits but inside the main house/casita/game room it was nice and cool."

reviews.title: Everything You Need!
reviews.comment: "The house was fantastic for 8 adults and 7 kids. It has everything you need! Jen was an amazing host! She responds so quickly and manages everything perfectly. Highly recommend the house and Jen."

reviews.title: Best experience so far!
reviews.comment: "Best, most beautiful and incredible place I’ve ever booked. Host responses were top notch as they were on top of everything, not only just the small things, but going above and beyond to make our stay feel right at home. If you need anything to be fixed, there is always someone on call who can help. We needed help with a light and someone came within 30 min to help at night time. They were very professional and quick. The house was clean, modern and spacious! It was very well thought out and provided endless activities for the kids to have fun and stay busy. Perfect place for families to spend quality time! Looking forward to booking with them again."

reviews.title: Private Resort
reviews.comment: "What a fantastic place for a group!!!! It was like staying at our own exclusive resort. From private guest rooms, to the well stocked game room to volleyball and the lazy river, everyone found something they loved 🥰"

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.comment: "The home was beautiful. The outdoor space was great for our group."

reviews.title: Wonderful Time!
reviews.comment: "We had a truly unforgettable stay at Jen’s Palm Springs home for our family reunion celebrating our 95-year-old grandma! The property felt like our own private resort — spacious, beautiful, and perfect for large groups. It was incredibly special to see four generations together, and our grandma had a wonderful time surrounded by her kids, grandkids, and great-grandkids. There was something for everyone — the game room, lazy river, pool slide, pickleball court, and volleyball court kept both kids and adults entertained all weekend. The house was comfortable, well-equipped, and thoughtfully prepared for our arrival. A huge thank you to Jen for the warm welcome and the yummy treats waiting for us — such a kind and personal touch. We’d love to return for another family trip, especially in the summer. Thank you again, Jen, for helping make this such a memorable experience for our whole family!"

reviews.title: Fantastic Family Stay
reviews.comment: "Our family of 13, ages 18 months to 88 years, had a fantastic time at Casa Mara! There was something for everyone to do and we were very comfortable in the home. There were plenty of sporting options, and all equipment was supplied. There was no need to ever leave! We also had a French Bulldog with us, and she absolutely loved having such a gigantic yard to run around in. We were at ease knowing the entire yard was securly fenced. The management was extremely responsive and helpful when we had questions. We would absolutely stay again!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars

reviews.comment: "It’s a pretty house .everything perfect"

reviews.comment: "We loved our stay at Casa Mara. There were 16 of us and we all had very comfortable amenities. The pool and hot tub were used nonstop. The floorplan is well thought out and never felt crowded. Highly recommend for a big group."

reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.comment: "Casa Mara is way better than the photos and the photos were great. What an amazing house and superb host. All 9 rooms were well appointed and clean. We can’t wait to return with all of our friends and family. The backyard was so fun and we loved the easy commute to Indian Wells tennis. The host texted me a few times per day to make sure we were doing well. The whole experience was just so easy. We absolutely loved it."

reviews.title: Perfect Spot for Annual Golf Trip
reviews.comment: "Place is perfect. Huge kitchen. Every guy gets his own room/bathroom. Hot tub is great. Ideal location from golf courses and dining and casino. Staff is so helpful - answered every text I sent within 10 minutes. Couldn't recommend high enough."

reviews.title: Perfect Space!
reviews.comment: "Jen was a great host! The house was perfect for the space. I would stay here again!"

reviews.title: Perfection!

It’s the only AIRBNB I’ve ever stayed in that the house and yard were bigger in person than they looked in pictures. Service was impeccable, as well. We had an absolutely wonderful time!"

reviews.title: Gorgeous Getaway!
reviews.comment: "We absolutely loved staying here! The house is gorgeous, lots of space to hang out and enjoy, the beds and pillows are so comfortable, plenty of restrooms including one by the pool for everyone to use, we only wished we could've stayed longer, it's a great getaway house!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Great place to spend with family. Lots to do on the premises."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "The place - the main house has 7 bedrooms and all are a nice size (1 is slightly smaller) but the primary is massive. They open up to a great room, which is where our party spent most of its time - big kitchen/ living room/ and dining area. They have a really nice room for kids too with BIG bunk beds for at least 4 kids which was great for our family of almost 14 - with 3 kids and 2 infants. Big laundry room to with 2 washers and 2 dryers. *the outside - fantastic space - family pool with slide which was used a ton (needed to be in 115 degree heat) - great slide - kids loved. Full sand volleyball court (saw less use due to heat and same with the basketball court. Pool was the main hub - its to a lap pool, but theres a mini lazy river quality to the wrap around nature (no actual jet powered stream) and a spa which looks great and served as a kid pool. Nice outdoor kitchen with a barbecue as well. great stay * please know in June/July/aug palm dessert is extremely hot (112)"

reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.comment: "This house has so much to do. You never have to leave. We definitely will be coming back. Best vacation ever."

reviews.title: Perfect vacation home
reviews.comment: "The house is perfect for a large group. Plenty of things to do on the property. Beautiful layout. Large kitchen."

reviews.title: Incredible!

reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.comment: "Property was perfect for a golf outing with friends. Highly recommended."

reviews.title: Highly Recommend!
reviews.comment: "Casa Mara was the perfect fit for a family vacation. The house was clean and well stocked. It was nice that it presented as pictured. The floor plan was conducive to all our needs. I would highly recommend this to anyone wanting a lovely spot for a family and friend vacation."

reviews.title: Beautiful Home
reviews.comment: "Jen’s home was very nice, this is not the first time my family stayed at one of her properties. Beautiful home with lots to do, we enjoyed our stay!! Will def book one of her properties in the near future."

reviews.title: A Truly Spectacular Experience!
reviews.comment: "We had 18 adults and 2 children here for my mother's 90th birthday. It was absolutely spectacular! The teens immediately took over each "play area" - game room, basketball court, lazy river, putting green, while the adults enjoyed the firepit with a nightly glass of wine. It was the perfect place for all of us to be together while enjoying so many different things to do. Great location to visit Joshua Tree and downtown Palm Springs when we weren't enjoying the house. Loved working with TRAVLR as well - they answered all my questions very quickly and the recommendations for restaurants and private chef were great. I was still hearing rave reviews from my family a full week after leaving!"

reviews.title: Perfect Space
reviews.comment: "place just as pictured. we spent Christmas there with 4 families and the space was perfect. Entertainment room was a hit along with the Pool."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "We booked Casa Mara for a group trip and it was fantastic. 9 couples stayed with at the house and there was plenty of room and privacy. The grounds made us feel like we were at our own private resort and the property manager was quick to respond to any questions that we had. The layout was perfect for a group trip (lots of hangout areas, but also plenty of space). Many special memories were created around the fire, in the game room, and in the hot tub. Everything was clean and thought of. We will be back!!"

reviews.title: Dream Backyard!
reviews.comment: "Had such a wonderful time at Casa Mara with a group of friends to celebrate my birthday. The house was beautifully decorated inside, amazing bathrooms, top appliances and stocked with all our needs. The backyard was where we spent the majority of our time though and it was wonderful! Hammock, outdoor grill, pool slide, hot tub, volleyball, fireside s’mores…the options were endless! The casita and gym + game room were fantastic as well- I only wish we had more time to enjoy everything! Jen was a great communicator and followed up in a timely manner to any questions or requests, both in getting settled into the house and throughout our stay. Would absolutely book again and recommend to any group looking for a backyard dream!"

reviews.title: Great for Groups!
reviews.comment: "Amazing location for big groups who want to relax and enjoy the sunny desert. Our team loved the different spaces to hang out, work in and also all of the activities like ping pong, billiards, an amazing pool and hot tub, beach volleyball court, etc. Communication with the host was really great - we ran into some small problems but Jen & team addressed them immediately with kindness and professionalism! :) Would definitely stay again!"

reviews.title: Great for Groups!

reviews.title: Great Experience!

reviews.title: Great Stay
