reviews.title: Amazing House
reviews.comment: "House was amazing. Unlike some places this house lives up to the photos. We didn't have a blender Saturday evening and they delivered us a new one within hours. No complaints and would recommend this house to anyone."

reviews.title: Throughly enjoyed by all
reviews.comment: "Casa Mara was enjoyed by 17 members of my family comfortably for my 80th birthday. It’s a beautiful, clean property! The large yard gave my Grandkids a place to run and play. The pool with the slide was throughly enjoyed by all. It was located close to grocery and drug stores."

reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.comment: "Amazing property, exceeded our expectations. The communication with the property management team was easy & timely, easy check in. This is a great place to bring the family together, I highly recommend."

reviews.title: Impeccable & Clean
reviews.comment: "Casa Mara was fabulous! The house itself was impeccable and clean. The beds were comfortable, the toiletries were great and the kitchen was fairly well stocked. Several in our group had to work during our vacation, as well, and the internet was very good. The outside area at Casa Mara was spectacular with activities for everyone, including in the "Playground." So many fun games to play and having the Peloton equipment was definitely an added bonus. You can easily vacation in the desert without ever having to leave this property! The location was also perfect, in between La Quinta and Palm Springs. It was an easy walk to the Indian Wells Tennis Garden and a quick drive to El Paseo. Although we had small issues that came up during our 11 days at Casa Mara, the management company was always very responsive, taking care of our needs almost immediately. We had such a good time and look forward to a return visit!"

reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.comment: "Great property and owners highly recommend. We stayed here during a work conference off site and was perfect for my team"

reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations!
reviews.comment: "Exceeded our expectations. Any questions we had with your staff were answered quickly. Our first VRBO and would definitely do it again."

reviews.title: Incredible Time
reviews.comment: "We had an incredible time. Your property is awesome you were so responsive to our needs. Often correcting things within an hour or so. This is an awesome property for a large group. Thank you"

reviews.title: Incredible Property
reviews.comment: "Incredible property just around the corner from the Tennis Garden. The backyard is a family oasis with so much to do! Well appointed house with lots of comfortable spaces to hang out and enjoy time with friends and families. Would definitely stay again."

reviews.title: Very Spacious!
reviews.comment: "very spacious and appealing for a large group....lots of places to play, enjoy, and occasionally work."

reviews.title: A Treat!
reviews.comment: "A treat to stay in this lovely house. Jen went way beyond to make our long-weekend comfortable and memorable. They gave us clear instructions of how to run all the ins and outs for the house. The beds were all very comfortable with nice bathrooms. The property looks exactly like it does in the pictures. Jen was very accommodating and very quick to respond with any questions I had. She was also flexible with check-in and check-out time, which was extremely helpful. The house is quiet, clean and spacious. Would definitely stay here again!"

reviews.title: Cannot recommend enough.
reviews.comment: "Amazing. That's the best word to describe Casa Mara. We were there for 4 days for a birthday celebration with a group of 16 and the place was fantastic. Lots of space, amazing amenities, and a super communicative host! Cannot recommend enough."

reviews.title: Something for Everyone!
reviews.comment: "Even better in person! 16 people for a family weekend, plenty of room. We spent all day in the pool with a very lazy river, game room, basketball, volleyball, putting green, relaxing, and cooking in the huge kitchen. So much to do, something for everyone!"

reviews.title: Very Enjoyable
reviews.comment: "An amazing house for large groups with kids. The pool & playroom were a hit and made the stay very enjoyable."

reviews.title: BEST time at Casa Mara!!
reviews.comment: "Our family of 16, ages 8 months to 70 years, had the absolute BEST time at Casa Mara!! As beautiful as the photos are, the property is even more beautiful when you see it in person! There was more than enough space for our crew to have privacy if they wanted, naps for the babies, and each of the rooms was so bright and airy and so nicely decorated. The huge kitchen was perfect for making meals together and the outside grill area was perfect for our barbecues! We enjoyed eating our meals outside and one night sat around the fire pit and made s'mores!! The pool is gorgeous and with the water slide was a huge hit with the grandkids! We had volleyball games on the nice court, basketball games, and games of pool while a few of us kept up our exercise routines on the treadmill! We never needed to leave the property (and we didn't want to) and seriously we barely had time to do everything there was to do at Casa Mara! From our first rental inquiry, our questions were answered quickly and the Property Manager was in contact with us from the minute we arrived and very responsive if we needed assistance during out stay. We can't wait to visit Casa Mara again!! Don't hesitate to rent this fabulous property, you will be so happy you did!!"

reviews.title: This place is amazing!
reviews.comment: "This place is amazing! There was a zen about the house that made us feel at home. Communication was great. The neighbor was even friendly welcoming us to this luxury home. There was plenty of space for my whole family to enjoy themselves together and individually. We loved how clean everything was! We will be staying here again in the future."

reviews.title: Perfect Place for our Large Group
reviews.comment: "This was a perfect place for our large group to come for the weekend. The house, kitchen and bedrooms were all top quality and the pool/gaming areas were awesome. Would definitely book again!"

reviews.title: Beautifully appointed, well-maintained, and very clean
reviews.comment: "Casa Mara was the perfect location for our girls weekend retreat! Beautifully appointed, well-maintained, and very clean. The bedrooms were a great size and the beds were very comfortable. Both the indoor and outdoor space were perfect for a large group looking to spend time together and relax in the sun. We would definitely come back next time we are in Palm Springs!"

reviews.title: Amazing house with endless activities!
reviews.comment: "Amazing house with endless activities! Loved the game room and the outdoor movie screen. Will definitely stay there again."

reviews.title: I would recommend this place highly.
reviews.comment: "So a group of 12 guys decided to get together to play a golf tournament and we chose La Quinta California. We found a great property 10 minutes away in Palm Desert, Casa Mara. We have stayed at hotels as a group before but we opted for something different this time. This fantastic property had a bed for everyone, yes, that's correct 12 beds, one for each guy. Plenty of restrooms and showers as well. But as good as the sleeping accommodations were, the kitchen and family room and pool and outdoor area and the indoor playground in the back were absolutely off the charts amazing! We went to Costco to procure our food for the four nights that we were there so that we could cook together and eat together and spend time whereas if we were at a hotel things are always so much more complicated. This house provided a great gathering experience for all of us. This place had plenty of TVs and a Sonos sound system so that we could play music by the pool and in the house. Fantastic air conditioning system and a perfectly set temperature on the pool made for a great for night stay. I would recommend this place highly. One of the features that made our stay great was the concert communication from the property manager, Kim. She was responsive to any requests that we had and it was very comforting to know that she could help us if we needed anything. Again, this is a beautiful property with lots of space for a large group to hang out in. We are looking forward to book in this house again in the future. Hit em straight!"

reviews.title: The Amenities are Unbeatable
reviews.comment: "This is the perfect house for a largish (~16) group of people to spend a great weekend together. The amenities are unbeatable, the house is well thought out and tastefully appointed, and check in and contact with the listing agent easy."

reviews.title: If you are comparing those house to another one, pick this one
reviews.comment: "If you are comparing those house to another one, pick this one. Our group including kids from 2-5 and 4 adults had a great time. Worth every penny. Texted a couple questions to the property manager and heard back within minutes every time. The pool, lazy river, and waterslide kept everyone entertained all day long every day. The game room was huge and wonderful too. Couldn't have been more pleased with everything."

reviews.title: An all around good stay!
reviews.comment: "This place has an amazing outdoor space and is very well designed inside. We had a large group and it was very comfortable. The management company was friendly and responsive. An all around good stay!"

reviews.title: We look forward to many returns!
reviews.comment: "We found the home in perfect condition. The accommodations were perfect for our group of 10. We had plenty of space to meet, relax, cook, swim etc. It really was the perfect spot for our retreat! We look forward to many returns!"

reviews.title: Terrific Property
reviews.comment: "Casa Mara is a terrific property. It has several areas to gather as to not feel cramped and allow for groups to relax, play games, cook, eat and enjoy. The host is very responsive and addressed all our questions and needs. Clean and well appointed. Thanks!"

reviews.title: AMAZING in Every Way!
reviews.comment: "This place is AMAZING in every way! The photos are beautiful, but when you see this property in person, it is truly jaw dropping! Every detail was thought out, everything is so comfortable and there is truly no reason to leave the home when you are there. Jen is a wonderful host, very prompt and thorough in her communication. We truly had the best time and no one wanted to leave!"

reviews.title: Place was Great
reviews.comment: "Place was great."

reviews.title: We highly recommend a stay at Casa Mara
reviews.comment: "We had a great time at Casa Mara. Our group of 13 enjoyed using the pool, spa and gameroom throughout our stay. Everything was very clean and well supplied. The property manager was very responsive. We highly recommend a stay at Casa Mara."

reviews.title: Highly Recommend Staying Here
reviews.comment: "Casa Mara was perfect for our group! The property was immaculate and the 24/7 assistance was always quick to respond with our questions. We got so much use out of the pool, the peloton, and the rest of the gorgeous backyard. Highly recommend staying here."

reviews.title: Highly recommend staying here
reviews.comment: "Casa Mara was perfect for our group! The property was immaculate and the 24/7 assistance was always quick to respond with our questions. We got so much use out of the pool, the peloton, and the rest of the gorgeous backyard. Highly recommend staying here."

reviews.title: Great House
reviews.comment: "Great house, outdoor area and pool. I highly recommend it."

reviews.title: Favorite Family Vacation so Far!
reviews.comment: "If you are looking for a fun gathering place for a large group, and you value clean, new, and beautiful facilities with tons of play options, look no further! We just spent 3 nights at Casa Mara with our 7 grandchildren and 7 kids celebrating our 40th anniversary, and EVERYONE said it was our favorite family vacation so far! No need to ever leave this well-designed property with so much space to spread out and quietly relax or gather together to loudly play! Our favorite activities were definitely the outdoor water slide, lazy river, spa, putting green, fire pit and indoor game room air hockey, ping pong, Pelotons, puzzle building table, and big screen TV! Plenty of refrigerators throughout to keep drinks and snacks cool and handy. Kitchen well equipped and beds and linens so comfy! It’s like they thought of everything! Only downside is the cost, once all the mandatory fees are added.🙈 But if you can save up enough pennies, you won’t regret it!👍🏼 Thanks, Casa Mara Team, for your designing such an amazing home, maintaining it so well, and managing with excellent communication support!"

reviews.title: Great house on a great property!
reviews.comment: "Great house on a great property! Lots room, and there was no reason to leave once we arrived."

reviews.title: Outstanding Property and Property Management
reviews.comment: "The property was outstanding, as was the property management. We ran into a few minor issues and a simple text and voila, it was resolved immediately. If you have a large group with disparate schedules and activities, this is a great place - plenty of space to move around, be with the group or be by yourself. We used every inch of the property and absolutely loved it!"

reviews.title: We hope to book it again next year!!
reviews.comment: "What a fabulous venue for our family getaway. We hope to book it again next year‼️"

reviews.title: Truly Memorable
reviews.comment: "Was lucky enough to find this property and get the chance to see the incredible details and care that the owner has done to ensure the renter experience is not a disappointment. My wife enjoyed a relaxing weekend wife friends for her 40th birthday and couldn’t have been more happy with the home but also the chef and massage therapists that were provided by the property manager. Truly a memorable weekend and birthday."

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.comment: "Wow, I'm not sure where to start with this property and the exceptional service that was provided with it! It is such a beautiful home with all the amenities you could ask for. So many different activities for the kids and adults! Beautiful pool with a lazy pool. Awesome place to come and relax. I will definitely be coming back to this property!"

reviews.title: The house is absolutely beautiful!!
reviews.comment: "We recently stayed at Casa Mara in Palm Desert and had the most AMAZING time with our friends and family!! The house is absolutely beautiful!! The bedrooms were spacious and the decor well thought out, classy and on point!! The kitchen and living space was made to accommodate a big group. Never felt crowded! There are no words for the backyard space!! Definitely, no need to leave the property!! There were amenities to satisfy adults and kiddos!! Absolutely felt like we were at our own private resort!! We can't say enough except that we will definitely return!! "

reviews.title: We cannot say enough about Casa Mara!
reviews.comment: "My family and I recently stayed at Casa Mara and had an incredible experience. The park-like grounds left no one asking for more…we played volleyball on a full size sand court, swam for hours in the pool (which had a lazy river and slide!!!), had putting contests, shot some hoops and relaxed in hammocks placed throughout the property. We enjoyed making s’mores in the outdoor fire pit and bbq’d most of our meals using the full outdoor kitchen….this was just our experience outdoors. The main home was immaculate…clean, well appointed and very very spacious. Every room and bathroom were like new with the most state-of-the-art amenities (charging docs, smart tv’s, WiFi, etc.). Our party included 12 people…7 adults and 5 boys and we never felt like we didn’t have our own private space. The open concept allowed for the 12 of us to eat, play games and watch tv very comfortably. When we cooked indoors it was a breeze because of the top of the line appliances and the endless supply of cookware. Like everything else, no expense was spared in the game room and casita. It had Peloton work out equipment and every game possible for the kids to enjoy. The massive movie theater like screen was perfect way to watch the Jungle Cruise movie! We cannot say enough about Casa Mara! We will definitely be back!"

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.comment: "AMAZING is how I would describe this vacation home! My family and I stayed at this beautiful rental for a few days and we had the best time ever! The property was very accommodating and a perfect location for a fun getaway. For those who like to explore, the area offers restaurants and stores very close. The property offered so much to do for the whole family like the Game room, lazy river pool, volleyball court and so much more. We were always entertained. I look forward to visiting again and will always recommend this rental to friends and family as one of the best I’ve ever stayed at. It was such a great experience thank you for hosting us!"

reviews.title: Everything about this house says luxury and elegance!
reviews.comment: "Everything about this house says luxury and elegance! We all enjoyed the expansive grounds, the pool, the game room and even the volleyball court! Our group consisted of 4 families (12 people total!) and not once did we feel overcrowded, everyone was able to have their own space and spread out. Our favorite time of the day was cooking big family size dinners in the state of the art kitchen and then jumping in the pool for a night swim and fun on the slide! We would definitely recommend a stay at this amazing property and we can't wait to go back!!!"

reviews.title: 5-Star Luxury Rental Home Great for Big Families/Groups
reviews.comment: "We cannot say enough great things about Casa Mara in Palm Desert! We recently stayed there with three other families and had a wonderful experience. The house itself is gorgeous, decorated beautifully with all the latest technology and equipment – no detail has been overlooked. The main house is light and spacious, providing more than enough room for groups to congregate comfortably. The rooms were clean and comfortable with just the right number of beds and bathrooms for each couple, and the ‘kids’ room with bunk beds was perfect for all our boys. Outside, the lazy river pool and water slide was a huge bonus, not to mention the playroom located at the back of the property that had just about everything you could want – huge TV, pool table, air hockey, foosball table, ping pong table and more. There was also a Peloton bike and treadmill. There’s really no need to leave the property while there because there is so much to do! Overall, we had a wonderful experience and will definitely be returning. Would highly recommend this property to anyone looking for a large group/family getaway with all the luxury appointments."

reviews.title: Can't wait to go back!
reviews.comment: "This house and property were amazing. Honestly don’t have words to describe how happy my family was during our stay. There is always something for the kids to do and plenty of room to separate and relax. Can’t wait to go back!"

reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.comment: "This property reached ALL of the family members expectations. It's relatively new, so the rooms and bathrooms are clean. Amenities are a bit limited in regards to the bathrooms and some parts of the kitchen. Overall, great place to stay with extended family members. We had 16 people in total, plus a medium size dog. There was enough space for adults to work and play, and the kids just played."

reviews.title: This house went far beyond our expectations
reviews.comment: "This house went far beyond our expectations. It is all that was advertised and more. First it is clean. Really clean. The maintenance staff and cleaning staff are obviously top notch. All rooms were carefully and tastefully appointed without trying too hard. the beds are nice and the covers and blankets are nice. Nothing in the house felt cheap. The kitchen had an abundance of glasses, plates, flatware, and cooking utensils. Everything worked. Nice TV's and lots of them. The pool was super fun, although keep in mind the main part is not huge. It's as pictured and clean but you're probably not going to get a big party game going in the pool. the kids loved the slide and all was clean and worked. All the grounds are well taken care of. The game room was fantastic and again, everything worked. All the furniture was clean and comfy. Wifi was fast. Communication was good too. Normally I wouldn't recommend such a nice house because I prefer to keep it to myself (joking) but this house is just so nice we even started thinking about buying something like it. If you're planning to have a big messy party here it's probably the wrong place because you won't be able to cover up damage and excessive messes as any would be obvious, and there isn't much to do near the property itself (just an ordinary neighborhood) This house is best suited for neat and responsible purposes, like family gatherings, not for a raging party. "Well done" to the owners! We look forward to an opportunity to stay again."

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.comment: "This was an excellent property for 2 families and 7 kids!!!"

reviews.title: Just as advertised and even more
reviews.comment: "The hosts were very responsive and the property was absolutely impeccable! Just as advertised and even more. The water slide is truly the cherry on top!"

reviews.title: Had a blast
reviews.comment: "Great rental and good management."

reviews.title: FUN FUN FUN!
reviews.comment: "If you’re looking for a fun yet relaxing home for your group to enjoy in the desert, look no further. Casa Mara is it! This resort-like home is beautiful, modern and was perfect for my group of 13 adults. There were thoughtful touches throughout the home that made you feel like they really put a lot of effort into thinking about their guests and their wants/needs while away from home. The home was comfortable, fun and we enjoyed it so much, we never left the house. Each room was a good size and all the bedding was high quality. The pool with the lazy river is where our group spent most of our time while listening to music on the Sonos system and bbq-ing. We also made good use of the volleyball court and the game room…you read that correctly GAME ROOM, that is detached from the house so folks who want to stay up later than others can still enjoy themselves. The home also had a mini gym area that included a Peloton bike and treadmill, pool table, air hockey, ping pong table and more! There is something for everyone at this home – whether you feel competitive and want to play games, be active, or just lounge by the pool, fire pit or on a hammock enjoying a cold beverage. I can't wait to stay here again."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "The property was amazing. Great place with lots of amenities for a large group!Beautiful location! Great sleeping arrangements! Highly recommend"

reviews.title: Hope to be back!
reviews.comment: "Jen was a wonderful host! She was so kind, welcoming, and easy to communicate with. Everything was smooth from start to finish, and we really enjoyed our stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed. Would definitely recommend and would happily stay again!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Jen's place was perfect for our two families. The pool is large with a deep end and a slide - which we really liked. Lots of amenities. The property is pretty large but the social area - pool family room and kitchen - are central so that worked for us so we could all be in the same area. There is also pickleball, etc on the property. It was pretty dang hot and the air conditioning was spot on. Def recommend."

reviews.title: Casa Roca Rocks!
reviews.comment: "Casa Roca was a pleasure to stay at over Coachella weekend, 2026. Clean, out of the way(private), serene, and more beds than i could count. i could have slept in a different bed each night. Bedrooms, washrooms, kitchen, living area, yard etc were all kept clean, and good condition- pillows, sheets, bed linens, towels etc were all in appropriate condition as well. very comfortable."

reviews.title: Great for Groups
reviews.comment: "This was a great property for our group of 10, including 4 grandkids ages 6 and under."

reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.comment: "The house was immaculate and perfect for our big family get together. The kids loved the pool, pickleball court and bball hoop, and the adults enjoyed the outdoor living area. I would highly recommend this compound - we will definitely be back! Hosts were super responsive and professional. All around a great stay!"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Casa Roca was the perfect house for our family group of 16. We had a wonderful week. The management was very responsive."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Very beautiful property with great amenities for a large group or family. Very helpful host, anticipated our needs with great recommendations and always quickly responsive. Look forward to visiting again."

reviews.title: Amazing Place
reviews.comment: "What a wonderful place for a close family gathering - so much better than at a resort. The facility and amenities were amazing. The whole family - 14 people ranging in age from 3 to 85 - loved the weekend, thanks to the amazing accommodation. Cannot recommend highly enough!!"

reviews.title: Thoroughly Enjoyed
reviews.comment: "Would definitely stay again if our plans take us back to Palm Desert. House was very nice and roomy. Enough bedrooms and bathrooms. Kitchen was perfect. Amenities were everything the description said it was. Ver nice and quiet neighborhood. Safety was important for us and this property was very safe. Overall a great vacation!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Casa roca was amazing! Perfect for our large group that included 11 adults, 6 children and dogs. Jen was easy to communicate with and the house was impeccable. It was clean, had everything we needed, and the pool with the slide was great entertainment for kids and adults! We hope to come back in the near future!"

reviews.title: Spectacular!
reviews.comment: "50th birthday and a family reunion at the same time how spectacular everybody had plenty of space pool and hot tub were fun for all. Property management was great and tentative 10 needs that we had"

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.comment: "Amazing house. Jen was very communicative and helpful when we had any questions. Getting in and out of the house was a breeze. It’s a nice secluded area, didn’t even know we had neighbors. Perfect for 9-10 people to stay comfortably (or a lot more if you do two to a bed). Would definitely come back."

reviews.title: Lovely Stay
reviews.comment: "This home with its resort-like pool, hot tub, and all the sporting options was all we needed for a great family vacation. We were kinda crazy to visit in Aug, but the house's air conditioning and the pool kept us comfortable. We just kept to this property the whole time because it had everything we needed."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "This place is awesome - the photos don't even do it justice. I hosted a friend reunion here and we had such a blast, without even needing to leave the property. Jen was incredibly communicative and responsive throughout. I would absolutely stay here again"

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.comment: "Jen and the house were great. Beautiful house with lots of room and outdoor space. The bedrooms were all very nice and accommodated our large group perfectly. It felt like we were staying at a five star resort. The outdoor space was great as well with a lot of fun options (pickleball, bocce ball, etc.). Jen was very responsive to any questions and I would highly recommend this house to others."

reviews.title: Perfect Coachella Stay
reviews.comment: "Perfect house to stay during Coachella. Highly recommended"

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.comment: "Perfect house for our multigenerational trip. Spacious and well equipped"

reviews.title: Unforgettable Getaway!
reviews.comment: "I recently had the pleasure of staying at Casa Roca, and I can't recommend it highly enough! The host, Jen, was incredibly friendly and provided a wealth of local knowledge, suggesting hidden gems in the area that truly enhanced my visit, such as a mobile massage service and a catering service that provided a special meal for a large party. The accommodation itself was immaculate and beautifully decorated, blending comfort with style. Every detail was thoughtfully considered, from the cozy bedding to the well-equipped kitchen. I especially loved the stunning backyard! Overall, my stay was unforgettable. I wholeheartedly recommend this Airbnb experience to anyone looking for a perfect getaway. I can't wait to return!"

reviews.title: Everything We Needed!
reviews.comment: "We had an amazing time at this property! It had absolutely everything we needed and so many fun activities to enjoy! The decor is modern and beautiful and the landscaping is quintessential Palm Desert! All of our guests loved the house!! I will say that renting a car is highly encouraged as this property is a bit far from everything, so Ubers can get expensive. My only complaint is the sulfur/sewer smell that radiants on occasion due to it being located next to the house. We thought it was a gas leak at first, but turns out it was the sewage."

reviews.title: Another Great Travlr Experience!
reviews.comment: "We have stayed at many of the Travlr properties, and Casa Roca was yet another fantastic experience. The home provided every amenity you would want from a gourmet kitchen (2 refrigerators came in really handy), a beautiful pool, hammock grotto for those lazy afternoons in the shade, indoor and outdoor lounge areas, and plenty of bedrooms and bathrooms for our group of eight. Paige and the Travlr team are always attentive and responsive. We greatly appreciate the Travlr experience - thank you and we'll see you next time!"

reviews.title: Perfect Space
reviews.comment: "We had an amazing stay at this Palm Desert house for our group of 16! The space was perfect for our needs, with plenty of room for everyone. The hosts were incredibly accommodating and communicative, making the entire experience seamless. We loved the beautiful pool and well-maintained grounds—ideal for relaxing and enjoying the sunshine. We would definitely stay here again! Highly recommended!"

reviews.title: Perfection!
reviews.comment: "We are a large group, 4 families of 4! This house fit 16 of us with room to spare. Everything was perfect! So clean, beds were so comfy and the kitchen was stocked to perfection! We even had our groceries delivered and unpacked for us which was such a treat. We were able to arrive and get right to vacation mode! Would absolutely book again, no one wanted to leave."

reviews.title: Palm Desert Palace
reviews.comment: "This is my second time staying at Casa Roca and I highly recommend it. It's got a lot of bedrooms, and everyone can really spread out. We were five people and it felt like heaven - and surely would have if we had two families staying there. The pool was perfect - loved the water slide. We grilled outdoors, played bocce and used the putting green, had great meals, and everyone slept great in the peaceful surroundings. Don't miss the extraordinary views from the hot tub. Will 100% stay here again next time I need a palace in Palm Desert. This place has it all. But most of all - it has chill."

reviews.title: The Best!
reviews.comment: "Absolutely amazing property and very well set up and managed. I’ve been renting vacations houses for 15+ years for an annual group trip. This was the best house we have ever booked. Highly recommend!!!"

reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.comment: Thank you for everything! We all had an amazing time and can’t wait to come back next year. Our kids and grandkids didn’t want to leave! The pool and spa was never empty. If you have a large family this is the home for you.

reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.comment: "Our family of 4 along with two friends spent a week at Casa Roca. Obviously, we didn't need as much space as the home provides but it didn't feel too big. We loved the pool, but mostly the Pickleball court. We did the hikes recommended in the guide provided. It was very easy to get Uber drivers at short notice for some fabulous meals out. Highly recommend. Thank you"

reviews.title: High-quality Property
reviews.comment: "Fantastic, four day stay. Our recent trip to Palm Desert stay at Casa Roca was really great. The facility was first class but what was really impressive was the organization supporting our stay. TRAVLR has systems in place that guarantee that the house is in good condition, mechanical parts are in working order from the hot tub to the dishwasher, the rooms are comfortable, there are fresh bathing and swimming towels, there is a resource for when we have questions, communication documents were clear, and the kitchen was in fantastic shape in terms of items that we might need. Our host, Jen, was delightful to work with as was her associate, German, and the people we talked to on the TRAVLR hotline during and after hours. We rebooked the same house for next year immediately. Airbnb should also be commended for attracting such a high-quality property. We had a different experience in Scottsdale and Airbnb handled that exceptionally well. TRAVLR has 40 or so houses and is awesome."

reviews.title: First of many trips!
reviews.comment: "This was my first VRBO experience and I was completely satisfied. This was the first of many to come."

reviews.title: Great Family Trip
reviews.comment: "Fourteen of our family stayed for a week to attend our eldest son's wedding in front of the 18th green at Indian Wells C.C. Casa Rosa is spectacular both inside and outside. It's inside is spacious: large kitchen, two refrigerator/freezers, rooms for lounging, pool table, eight bedrooms all with TV's, (some bedrooms with private and others with Jack & Jill bathrooms) and one huge room with three beds, couch, large TV and more. The interior is just perfect for a large or smaller group. The outside property is loaded with activities for all ages: a bocce ball sand court, pickleball court, basketball hoop, putting green, three hammocks, large pool with hot tub on top of a hill, outdoor shower, outdoor kitchen/grill with large TV and sitting area (all in working order), picturesque views of the desert valley everywhere one looks...simply stated, we could not have been more pleased!"

reviews.title: Great Family Getaway!
reviews.comment: "Like the title says, this property offers a whole lot. We are an extended family - 6 adults, 4 kids (ages 3.5 to 8) and everyone was happy. The house is clean and spacious with lots of lounging areas, lots of bedrooms and bathrooms, and beds are very comfortable. Kitchen is well-equipped and has a nice layout with great room and patio door to outside. Outside, the pool is wonderful (we paid to have it heated a bit higher for January). Hot tub is great and views are lovely. We used the fire pit and all the other many outdoor amenities. Clearly, a lot of thought went into this home. Right down to the 2 washers and 2 dryers. We didn't feel the need to leave the property too much in 3.5 days, but there is great hiking nearby, plenty of restaurants, grocery. Communication, from start to finish, was excellent. (That's always a big plus in our book.) All in all, we highly recommend this home and most likely will rent again!"

reviews.title: Well Appointed
reviews.comment: "This was a beautiful home. Very spacious. Lots of fun things to do on the property. The bedrooms were very well appointed. Bathrooms were clean and the towels were fresh. The kitchen was also very well appointed. The backyard and the hot tub also excellent. Overall this was a great place to stay. We thoroughly enjoyed our trip here and Jen was very helpful for anything we needed."

reviews.title: Great Trip!
reviews.comment: "Really fun house, we had a great time."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Everything is great!"

reviews.title: Perfect & Well Kept!
reviews.comment: "This house was perfect for our group of 8. The home itself is well kept and well furnished. We enjoyed the time spent outside, very quiet and peaceful. And the hot tub was beautiful. The host was also incredibly responsive, answering any questions we had very quickly."

reviews.title: Magical Stay!
reviews.comment: "Our stay was magical. Exceeded our expectations. The house had everything we possibly could have needed, so much so that we hardly left. The views are beautiful and a short hike up a hill from the pool that was like a mini mountain hike for the kids, took us to one of the two jacuzzi’s and allowed an incredible view that went forever. We look forward to going back!!!"

reviews.title: Most Epic Home
reviews.comment: "This was hands down the most incredible Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. As beautiful as the pictures are, they don’t do it justice. I stayed here with a large group of girlfriends and there was plenty of space with no shortage of bedrooms / bathrooms. My favorite part of the property is the outside. The outdoor cabana is perfect for games and hanging out, the pool / water slide are perfect for warm days, and with the pickleball court, basketball, golf, etc there is limitless activities. I can’t forget the hot tub which is a short hike with insane views of palm desert and a gorgeous place to see the sunset. Everyone in our group said this was the most epic home they’ve ever stayed. Jen and her team were also very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. I cannot recommend enough!"

reviews.title: Great for All Ages!
reviews.comment: "Wonderful stay for family reunions. It was wonderful to spend time together with many things to do for all ages. Rooms were perfect with enough bathrooms for all. Two refrigerators was really nice for our group. The backyard amenities were beautiful. We definitely will use this property again!"

reviews.title: Will be Back!
reviews.comment: "Casa Roca was amazing. 3 generations with lots of space, great pool and jacuzzi. Thank you for hosting us Casa Roca. We will definitely be back☀️💙"

reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.comment: "Casa Roca was everything we hoped for and more. The spacious floor plan allowed for plenty of individual and group time. The pantry and extra frig were great assets. The surrounding setting was gorgeous, particularly the spa up in the backyard hill at sunrise."

reviews.title: Incredible Property!
reviews.comment: "We booked this incredible property after deliberating and comparing with other similar luxury rentals. Here’s why this one stood out over the rest: 1. King/ Cal King beds in every single bedroom. No one wants a Queen, unless it’s a shared room with multiple beds (like the lovely A-frame space which easily became our favorite room in the house. It’s perfect for a large family with multiple children or throw all your teens in one room!) 2. Gorgeous, cohesive design with luxury high end furniture. This detail might not matter to some, but for us, we wanted a highly instagrammable property to take loads of family pictures. Every single corner is so beautiful, our vacation pictures turned out amazing! 3. KILLER outdoor space. Pool was heavenly, even the adults loved the slide, there’s bocci ball, tennis, pickle ball, hammocks, large grassy area, covered veranda, outdoor grill… I could go on and on Gave this place 5 out of 5 stars, but here’s a note for improvement: - Fridge was beeping the entire time we were there. Maybe needed a filter change? - Microwave is not intuitive to use. Takes some getting used to. - Gas burners were very weak. We only got 1 good burner. It took over an hour to boil a pot of water to make pasta for our family. So be forewarned if you’re planning on cooking a lot. Overall, I would definitely book again next time we’re in town. Or perhaps even check out this property manager’s other local listings. They’re all so fab! You can’t go wrong!"

reviews.title: Everything was amazing!
reviews.comment: "This was one of the most beautiful Airbnb we have ever stayed at! Everything was amazing! Great amenities for kids and families. Beautiful views from the jacuzzi."

reviews.title: True Desert Oasis
reviews.comment: "Casa Roca was an absolutely gorgeous estate! The decor was stylish, the house was impeccably clean, and the amenities were amazing! We had a cousin’s annual family trip and everyone was impressed by this beautiful home. We loved that almost every bedroom had king size beds. The rooms and bathrooms were spacious. Don’t even get me started about the backyard. It was a true desert oasis. The host was easy to reach and made us feel very comfortable. They were quick to answer questions and address any issue that came up in a very timely manner. We couldn’t have been happier! We’ll definitely be back!"

reviews.title: Exceeded Expectatons
reviews.comment: "We loved this place. Had so much fun . Enjoyed the private setting. I never left the property once the entire stay. Everything exceeded our expectations."

reviews.title: First Class Property
reviews.comment: "First class property for large group or family. My wife and I celebrated our 40th anniversary with our kids and grandkids. No need to ever leave the property except visit to zoo or grocery store. So much to do and enjoy on site. Beds are super comfortable, and each bedroom is sound insulated. Lovely place."

reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.comment: "The property was beautiful! It had enough rooms for our group of 15. The pool and outdoor area is wonderful. We used the outdoor kitchen a couple of the nights and it was great. The property manager responded very quickly to our questions and requests."

reviews.title: Exactly what we needed!
reviews.comment: "The property was exactly what we needed for our couples trip. The interior is set up well to hang out in large groups or find little corners to hide away and read a book. The exterior is so fun and beautifully maintained."

reviews.title: Perfect for Groups!
reviews.comment: "This was perfect for an offsite. Fun, current and well appointed."

reviews.title: The property was FABULOUS
reviews.comment: "We surprised our dad for his 70th birthday. 6 kids, 7 adults. Kids aging 3-9 and what an incredible trip it was. It went by too fast! The property was FABULOUS , the amenities were top notch! Thank you for allowing our family to come from different parts of the country to gather here for such a special occasion!"

reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.comment: "The property was better than advertised. Amazing location with great amenities. The property is vast, with all the options to relax play and to entertain family and friends. I enjoyed both a business retreat with my senior staff holding meetings etc. Also had friends over for the weekend to golf and enjoy the property and just relax. All of the bedrooms were very comfortable, the beds were wonderful. High end Finishings throughout the home, the backyard is a dream to entertain in. From the pool to spa, to covered patio, nothing missed in this fantastic design. Highly recommend…"

reviews.title: Wonderful Week!
reviews.comment: "What a wonderful week! Fun for all ages at the property and close to hiking for easy adventures. Management was very accessible. Would love to stay again!"

reviews.title: Great for Large Groups!
reviews.comment: "We stayed here for a work/golf outing and it exceeded expectations. Everything clean and easy to use, and Jen was very responsive and helpful. A lot of room for everyone too! Highly recommend for any large group."

reviews.title: Stunning Home
reviews.comment: "This home is stunning. It's prettier in person than in the pictures. It is well appointed, beautifully decorated and the yard is an oasis. The service was top notch. Great stay all around."

reviews.title: WOW
reviews.comment: "WOW. What to say about this incredible home! From the moment we walked in, we were blown away by the style of the home, the incredible amount of space, the what seemed to be unlimited activities -- swimming in the huge pool, bocce ball, A PICKLE BALL COURT!, outdoor kitchen and dining table, hot tubs, hammocks, put put golf... Truly an amazing place for a small or large group -- I hosted my team of 10 there for a retreat for 5 nights and we did not get bored once. Close to palm desert where there were shops, grocery stores, restaurants, etc. Also super close to some hiking trails that we enjoyed. Not only was the house like a stunning mini-resort all to yourself, our hosts were incredible at helping answer any questions or helping assist any problems that came up - truly stellar hosting and communication, which we are thankful for. We can't wait to visit other properties of theirs for future retreats!"

reviews.title: We will be coming back!
reviews.comment: "All i can say is we love love love this home. So spacious for a large family. The kids enjoyed the slide but be aware its on the deeper end of the pool. Such a stylish comfortable home. We cant wait to come back! The host was so nice and checked in with us to make sure we didn't need anything. We will be coming back!"

reviews.title: Absolutely Beautiful
reviews.comment: "Pictures don't do justice for this house! It is absolutely beautiful and so nicely decorated! :) We had an amazing time here"

reviews.title: Wonderful Weekend!
reviews.comment: "This place was perfect for a long weekend getaway! The property was beautiful and the host was easily accessible the entire time. Everything you need is within a 20 min drive or less. We would definitely recommend our family and friends to stay here. Thank you for such a wonderful weekend!!!"

reviews.title: FELL IN LOVE WITH CASA ROCA!!
reviews.comment: Absolutely fell in love with Casa Roca!! Stayed with family and friends for a week!! Felt like we were in our own little private resort!! Inviting feel with beautiful decor from the moment you drive up!! We spent most of our time outside in the AMAZING pool and had most of our meals in the stunning outdoor patio! Pickle ball court, outdoor movie nights, and beautiful boho hammock area were a big hit with the teenagers as well as us grownups!! The jacuzzi with breathtaking mountain views was a relaxing little hideaway within our little paradise. Location was perfect!! Early morning walks around the neighborhood was my favorite way to start my days. This property was definitively meant to give you no reason to leave! But if you must, there is high end shopping and restaurants 5 minutes away! I kinda took advantage of that as well! I just can’t say enough! Very thoughtful attention and consideration was given to making this property the perfect getaway!Can’t wait to come back!!

reviews.title: Amazing house and service
reviews.comment: The house and property is better in person. I would highly recommend

reviews.title: Comfortable for a Big Family
reviews.comment: "The home was beautiful and comfortable for a big family. There was tons of activities for the children. We enjoyed spending our weekend there."

reviews.title: Like a 5 Star Resort!
reviews.comment: "This house was Aaaaammmmazzzing!!! Perfect for 3 families with tons of kids. Plenty of room. Literally everyone had a room. Views were to die for. Close to everything you need - food, shopping entertainment! The kitchen is well stocked. They even had bathrooms all stocked with plenty toilet paper, body wash, shampoo/conditioner (and not the cheap stuff). We bbq’ed most nights and ate outside by the pool. It really was like being at a private resort. We did encounter a snake on the pathway to the hot tub (2 days in a row). But…. It was not really next to us, it was minding its own business AND the owner was willing to send someone out to get it right away (it was non-venomous and the desert is it’s home). The key take away is the owner is super responsive! This was really like a 5 star resort!!! We would definitely rent it again."

reviews.title: Worth the splurge!
reviews.comment: "Worth the splurge! High end and fun."

reviews.title: Absolutely Dreamy
reviews.comment: "This property is absolutely dreamy and nothing short of the pictures. We stayed for 2 days and enjoyed every moment. The management team is also very responsive and professional and resolved any small issue that came up in a timely manner. I highly recommend this place!"

reviews.title: Breathtaking Property
reviews.comment: This home was absolutely phenomenal. Extremely clean, very well furnished and amazing amenities. Both fun for kids and adults! Agency was also amazing. Totally speechless! Will definitely be back to book with this agency even for the same house!

reviews.title: Great rental had everything you need
reviews.comment: "Great rental had everything you need. Great 2 nights spent there. Will definitely try to be back next year"

reviews.title: Epic!
reviews.comment: "This place is special beyond words. We played pickleball, soaked in amazing sunset pool evenings, and had amazing meals on the verandas. So many playful hummingbirds everywhere! The furnishings, décor, gathering spaces were impeccable. Management company was responsive with every question we had. Our family and friends are already planning 2027 fall return."

reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.comment:
"We had a large group stay here for a birthday celebration, and the property was even better than the pictures! There was so much space for everyone to spread out, and the hosts even left us a little birthday treat and note, which was such a thoughtful touch.



As a designer, I especially appreciated all of the attention to detail throughout the property. It felt incredibly cozy and is truly one of the nicest Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in. There are plenty of spaces for people to gather or sprawl out, and all of the amenities you could want. The gardens are also beautifully designed. lush, private, and especially impressive given the desert setting.



We loved that there are multiple homes on the property, which allowed everyone to have a little more privacy and their own space while still feeling like we were all together. Sonos throughout was amazing!



My only suggestion would be to reconsider the cost of EV charging. The rate felt a bit high for charging.



We absolutely loved our stay."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "My friends and I had the best time at Casa Tierra. Firstly, the property is perfect. I loved the stained glass in every room, mixed with the modern updates. It's decorated impeccably. It's hard to figure out where to spend your time because there are so many great rooms and also things to do. The pool is magical. The view is stunning. Doing yoga and the sound bath (shoutout to Katie) was grounding. There's not one flaw. I will definitely be staying here again."

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.comment: "Somehow, the pictures on this listing don’t do the house justice. It truly feels like you’re staying at a private resort with your family and friends. There’s plenty of space to enjoy some alone time, while still having great areas like the outdoor dining table and main living room to bring everyone together. The attention to detail throughout the house was very impressive, from the built-in speakers in every space to the furniture and beautiful architectural features. Highly recommend staying here if you’re looking for a private property with a true resort feel."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "This property is amazing. It's bigger than it looks in the photos, plenty of space and very luxurious. We enjoyed our stay so much."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Extremely happy, don't have anything negative to say, beautiful home, highly recommend to any one"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "We arrived and we were greeted with a handwritten note and crumbl cookies in each location. That was a nice touch. The Travlr team was on it!! There was no question, concern or information that went unanswered. The responsiveness of the team is unmatched. I’ve stayed at a lot of villas. Bravo to Taylor M. and her team for our oasis in the desert."

reviews.title: Would Recommend to Everyone!
reviews.comment: "My group at the time of our lives at this house - tons of space for activities, lounging, swimming, and enjoying each others’ company. We made good use of the pool, TV room, and kitchens - everything was well-supplied and easy to use. The casitas allowed for a lot of down time away from it all and the various bars, fridges, and ice machines kept the good times going the entire weekend. The property was stunningly gorgeous and the views expansive - we never wanted to leave!!! Can’t recommend this place enough and the hosts were responsive and communicative. Zero complaints and would love to return again another time!"

reviews.title: Breathtaking!
reviews.comment: "10/10 experience! The property grounds are breathtaking. Every little detail was well thought out. We were blown away by how gorgeous the house was and swooning for our entire stay! The host was extremely responsive and we really appreciated how quickly they acted to answer our questions. So excited to hopefully stay here again!"

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.comment: "Our family had a lovely time at this beautiful property and the owner's are wonderful to work with. Thank you!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Our guests had a great time here! Great host and team"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Very responsive and helpful host. Would love to return."

reviews.title: Magical Wedding Weekend
reviews.comment: "We reserved Casa Tierra for our wedding celebration with our small family and close friends. I had envisioned the property providing a perfect backdrop for the event. But it was so much more! The property is even more beautiful than photos could ever show. Not a detail has been missed. We used every bed available and every guest was beyond comfortable. The kitchen was well-stocked for our group. Courtney was an excellent contact for plans relating to the wedding. Our family stayed onsite, while our small group of friends stayed at nearby airbnbs and hotels and car pooled via uber without issue to the property. We also made use of the concierge service to host a beautiful rehearsal dinner the night before. My only regret was that we didn’t book it for a week; 4 nights wasn’t enough to enjoy everything this property had to offer! The pool was amazing. And there are so many special places across the property to hang out. The sound system was incredible. Seamless check-in and check-out. We can NOT wait to go back!! What a magical and special trip!"

reviews.title: Every aspect was perfect
reviews.comment: "Couldn’t have had a better place to celebrate a birthday weekend with friends. Somehow Bobby’s place is even better than the photos."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "The photos do not do it justice! This is a very special place where every detail is thought of. From the welcoming entry into the house/grounds and automatic lighting, to the workout mats and various ice making machines, you have what you need at every turn. Will look forward to returning!"

reviews.title: Perfect Stay
reviews.comment: "The host was awesome and always available and the stay was perfect."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Bobby’s home is amazing! The photos don’t do the property justice. It’s well designed and just the perfect home to unplug and relax. We had a large group and enjoyed the yoga deck every morning with its views of the canyon and golf course. The pickle ball court was also fun to play day or night with the lights. A nice big fire pit with plenty of seating was fun in the evenings. The pool area is like you are at a resort! This place is an 11/10 top notch property!"

reviews.title: Magical!
reviews.comment: "We had a magical time gathering with friends and family. We made great use of every room and part of the property!"

reviews.title: Unforgettable!
reviews.comment: "If you're thinking about booking the oasis, I'd say "go for it." It is even more stunning and beautiful in person. Every detail, every design, every piece of outdoor furniture, etc has been thought out so thoughtfully. You won't regret staying here - it is absolutely bliss and the team communicates very quickly to respond to questions."

reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.comment: "I mean holy cow!! Everyone knows the photos are better than the real thing but THIS PLACE the photos did not do justice. This was a retreat. My entire family stayed here for my wedding and we all had our own space with huge rooms to stay in then an insane amount of common rooms for us to hangout. We all swam in the pool, had a pickle ball tournament, woke up early for yoga on the deck and watched a movie on our final night. I genuinely had a magical time here and will be booking again for our anniversary! I can’t say enough good things about this stay! The host responded within minutes every time I had a question and the house was SPOTLESS. We are so so happy with how this vacation week turned out."

reviews.title: Cherished Memories
reviews.comment: "Somehow, the photos do not do Bobby's place justice. Aside from every corner being stunning, the communication was excellent, location was serene, amenities were amazing. It was perfect for our ladies weekend away (...17 of us felt the same!)"

reviews.title: A Gem
reviews.comment: "I recently celebrated my birthday weekend at the absolutely gorgeous Casa Tierra in Palm Desert, and it was truly an amazing experience. The property itself felt like our own secluded resort, and I couldn’t have asked for anything more perfect. Everything from the amenities to the ambiance was just top-notch. The Travlr team was incredibly responsive and kind throughout the entire process, making sure we had everything we needed and answering any questions we had promptly. It really made the stay feel special and effortless. I’d give this place a 10 out of 10 and can’t wait to visit again. If you’re looking for a beautiful, relaxing getaway spot, I highly recommend booking this gem!"

reviews.title: Perfect private resort in the desert!
reviews.comment: "Casa Tierra is a truly amazing property with incredible design, amenities, and overall privacy. Perfect for a large group relaxing getaway in the desert. Highly recommend!"

reviews.title: Exceeded expectations!
reviews.comment: "Casa Tierra was even more beautiful in person. Pictures can’t even capture the beauty of the whole property. Every detail was carefully curated and every corner was made intentional. The team was extremely helpful throughout the stay and I can’t wait to visit again."

reviews.title: Absolutely Gorgeous!!!!
reviews.comment: We were all there this past weekend to celebrate my birthday and absolutely loved the property. We didn't even really want to go out anywhere. I just loved the interior design and the amazing pool. We will definitely be back!!!

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "I had a group of 16 spend a long weekend at Casa Tierra for my 40th birthday. I knew the property looked amazing from the pictures, but nothing quite prepared me for when we got there. The entrance was quite grand, and I immediately felt excited as the gates opened. Upon walking into the property, there was already soft, peaceful music playing. The pool area was set up with rolled up towels on each Lounger. The property itself is just beautiful. There are so many different areas to convene; Pickleball, Jen recommended a great yoga Teacher and we did yoga on the platform, dinner in the courtyard and at the grand dining room table, karaoke in The dark media room. The night landscaping lights were gorgeous. I texted the property management company a few times asking for clarification and got a helpful response within five minutes every time. So amazing The only thing to be prepared for is that the loft bed space is quite small, probably better for a single person or younger people."

reviews.title: Our Own Resort
reviews.comment: "Amazing house. Truly felt like a resort all to ourselves. Beds were comfy, the entire place is straight out of a magazine, and we had the best time hosting friends and family for our small intimate wedding."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Met at the site for a small family wedding. The bride and groom's families stayed and thoroughly enjoyed all the amenities particularly the pickeball court. Management company was easy to reach, responded quickly and was flexible. Excellent stay."

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.comment: "Loved the layout and amenities!"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "5-Stars"

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.comment: "Casa Tierra is an absolute DREAM!!! This is a compound- multiple houses, amazing pool, beautiful views, lots of activities, and the privacy element is amazing. My family came for the weekend and everyone was amazed by the space. The architecture and design and impeccable and the comfort comes from all the amenities and thoughtful elements. If you are looking for a space for a celebration, escape, or want to feel like you’re in paradise for the weekend, you’ve found the space. Not to mention the host is super responsive, suggested a chef and other things to do, and allowed us to have early check in. Thank you so much Bobby and team for making our weekend so special."

reviews.title: Something for Everyone
reviews.comment: "We had 17 people for a family reunion aged 72 though 10. There was plenty of things for everyone in the group to do including swimming, pickle ball, yoga, video games, bocci ball, jenga, board games, and more. The property is in a secluded location and looks exactly as shown in photos. We couldn't have found a better place. Close to town, restaurants, hiking, shopping, nothing was too far away. Very memorable stay, look forward to staying here again."

reviews.title: A Perfect Oasis
reviews.comment: "This property is top notch. Our group was so comfortable in our own little oasis. Its was the perfect place to unwind, cook, drink wine, hang by the pool and enjoy with friends. We recommend it to anyone looking to stay."

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.comment: "Amazing experience! Secluded and felt like you are in your own resort. The grounds are amazing!!"

reviews.title: An Oasis
reviews.comment: "This was a true oasis. The home and property was breathtaking, clean and so peaceful. It was the absolute perfect stay and we would 100% rebook. They were also so responsive and helpful with every need."

reviews.title: If you've ever wanted to visit paradise, look no further!
reviews.comment: What an incredible vacation destination. We came here with 4 other families for a summer send-off and boy were we impressed. The grounds are spectacular and Bobby has truly thought of everything when designing each space. We never wanted to leave!!! I joked that I want to be buried here so I can haunt Casa Tierra for all eternity. With that said, don’t worry - no ghosts. Lots of beautiful hummingbirds though!

reviews.title: Holiday Party
reviews.comment: We celebrated our daughter’s first birthday with our friends at Casa Tierra. It was great to have the different casitas so we all had our own space but still were able to spend time together. Especially with children who nap at different times.

reviews.title: Incredible Stay
reviews.comment: "We had an incredible stay at this stunning property! It’s beautifully maintained, and we felt right at home the moment we arrived. The hosts were very responsive, making our experience even smoother. This home is ideal for group gatherings, with two spacious indoor tables and large outdoor tables that comfortably accommodate everyone. The kitchen is fully equipped, with plenty of bowls, plates, and silverware—perfect for hosting a large group. Cooking enthusiasts will appreciate the well-appointed kitchen, although it's worth noting that the oven is a conduction stovetop which can be a challenge. Throughout the property, there are cozy enclaves with seating, perfect for relaxing, and a lovely fire pit that adds to the ambiance. The outdoor activities and game room was a hit with us. While the cost is on the higher side, the experience and the setting make it absolutely worth it for those looking to celebrate with a group of fabulous friends. We couldn’t have asked for a better place."

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.comment: "Our group of 12 girls felt so fortunate to stay at Bobby's home. It was absolutely stunning. Every single detail of the decor was perfection! The home was beyond spacious and comfortable, and we only wish we had more time to utilize all of the incredible outdoor spaces! We would come back in a heartbeat!"

reviews.title: Soul Nourishing! The Best Weekend Getaway with Friends
reviews.comment: My husband, a group of friends, and I recently stayed at Casa Tierra for a final summer getaway, and it exceeded all our expectations. After a month of admiring the photos, the villa proved to be even more stunning in person. Casa Tierra is simply breathtaking. From its meticulously designed landscaping to the exquisite interiors, every detail radiates elegance and comfort. The blend of glamour and relaxation was perfect. We fully immersed ourselves in the experience—soaking up the sun by the pool, dining together in the charming courtyard, engaging in lively pickleball matches, and savoring sunsets by the fire pit. The property struck a perfect balance between seclusion and connection with nature. I only wish we could have stayed longer! While we enjoyed it with friends, I can easily see Casa Tierra being an ideal spot for family reunions or holiday celebrations. I wholeheartedly recommend Casa Tierra for anyone seeking a luxurious and memorable.

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.comment: "Book now!! This property is everything we wanted and more. Photos cannot quite capture the beauty and serenity of this incredible home. But perhaps even more than this stunning property with its magnificent views, our group of friends truly appreciated Bobby, Jen and the whole staff. From the initial booking through the weeks leading up to our stay and finally throughout our stay, communication was incredibly timely (messages/questions were answered within minutes, sometimes seconds). Bobby and Jen went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed. We received such a special surprise upon our arrival, we are still in shock and we can’t thank the team enough for all of their hard work. As a bonus, we suggest having the team pre-stock the villa ahead of arrival. We were able to walk in and start our vacation immediately with a fully stocked kitchen and bar! Thank you Bobby and Jen for a vacation we will never forget!"

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.comment: "Beautiful place, great for groups, clean, lots of privacy. Beautiful pool and pool house. Had a great time. Would recommend to others."

reviews.title: Perfect Venue for Micro Wedding
reviews.comment: Rented this house for our daughter's 15-person micro-wedding in May. It was the perfect venue with endless picture-perfect options for photos, meals, and activities. It's like having your own private resort. The pool area is amazing. In addition, the house was clean, well appointed, and rooms are well laid-out for everyone to not feel like they were on top of each other. There are quite a few steps both inside and out so if you have anyone with mobility issues it could be challenging. The TRAVLR staff was very responsive and helpful with all of our questions. We had a number of pretty specific inquiries about types of dishes and glasses, etc. (for the wedding dinner) and they were always prompt and thorough in their replies. They even tracked down and shipped some bathing suits that were left behind. We appreciated their attention to detail. Casa Tierra exceeded all expectations - I just wish we had stayed longer!

reviews.title: Amazing Wedding Stay!
reviews.comment: "Travlr was amazing leading up to and during our stay at Casa Tierra. Paige would answer my emails with all my questions promptly and made sure we had all the dishes and things we needed to make our weekend everything and more. They helped us find a chef, massages to come to the house and made a lot of other suggestions in the area. 10/10 I would stay at Casa Tierra again and I would book through Travlr again in a heartbeat."

reviews.title: Felt Like a Resort!

We also loved the screening room! Casa Tierra was designed with such care and love. We thoroughly enjoyed our experience. There is no shortage of drink refrigerators. Ice machines were great. We used everything this great vacation spot had to offer except the fire pit unfortunately because we ended up having some wind the night we were going to use it. There are two 1/2 baths - off the kitchen and down by the pool. The four bedrooms in the main house had their own baths en-suite. The upper casita has a Jack n Jill bathroom with a King bedroom & full bunk beds. The pool casita has bedroom, full bed, bath & kitchenette. Jen was a great host and we will definitely be back!"
