The kitchen comes fully stocked. The house has a great layout and was very clean. The host is extremely quick to reply to any questions. Would definitely visit again!"

reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.comment: "The Jaguar estate was everything I wanted for a weekend getaway with some of my best buddies. The inside of the house was beautiful and spacious and had everything we needed for sleeping arrangements. 95% of the time we were out by the lower pool. The outdoor living space of the Jaguar estate is why I chose the house and it exceeded expectations. Jen was quick to respond with questions and made the check in process seamless. I would definitely recommend this property!"

reviews.title: Blown Away!
reviews.comment: "We had a group of 14 and it was perfect for us! Everything was exactly as pictured and much larger than expected. Everyone was blown away by the property. Would 100% rent again!"

reviews.title: Spectacular!
reviews.comment: "Spoke with Jen a bunch before we actually stayed at the Jaguar Estate. Had an excellent time at the location. House is spectacular and incredibly fun. Extremely well maintained. Rooms were spectacular. House was actually much bigger than we had anticipated. We had a fun group that was never bored because of how much there was to do. Jen was always extremely responsive with any questions that I had. Would absolutely recommend staying."

reviews.title: 5 Star Vacation!
reviews.comment: "Really great place for a family vacation. Jen is very helpful. Overall five stars experience."

reviews.title: No Expenses Spared!
reviews.comment: "The house was beautiful and just as described. You can tell they did not spare any expenses - high quality kitchenware, furniture, etc. I would absolutely recommend for a fun activity-filled trip with friends and family. We went in August so it was a bit hot but certainly doable."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Beautiful house"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "The house was even better than advertised, clean and well outfitted with the necessities. Would stay again."

reviews.title: Amazing Amenities
reviews.comment: "Beautiful house with amazing amenities. Plenty of space for my large group inside and outside. Highly recommend this property for a long weekend full of outdoor activities"

reviews.title: This house was amazing!
reviews.comment: "Not only was the house beautiful and spacious but the grounds were beyond incredible. We could’ve easily spent the whole winter there! The management was incredibly responsive if we had any questions. They always replied to my texts right away with helpful information. Our whole family of 6 had the best time staying there. It was the perfect house!"

reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.comment: "What a trip this was, from check in, to check out it was perfection. We decided to head to Palm Desert to have the extended family together for Christmas. The imagery provided on the property is spot on and it was an unexpected treat to arrive and find the property exactly as described. The house is pristine, but the sport amenities made this one of the most fun times we've had on a family escape. We played pickle ball, used the putting green, played soccer and corn hole. Morning coffee by the outdoor fireplace was heaven and the kitchen so well stocked for a rental. (Boyfriend is a chef, so it was a happy surprise.) Only comment I would make is if the weather is cold, perhaps don't spend the money on heating the pool. We did and the pool never heated to the temperature we were told, but it also could have been due to the cool outdoor temperatures. But it was money just thrown away. That said, the hot tub got hot and the overall experience made up for it. In a word...divine."

reviews.title: Like a Resort!
reviews.comment: "I loved our stay at Jaguar! Amazing resort style house that lives up to the pictures and description. Couldn’t be better I would definitely rent again."

reviews.title: Family Getaway
reviews.comment: "We have 8 adults and 7. Children!!! There was plenty of room! The property was unbelievably! 2 pools …pickle ball.. games…. Volleyball… The kids were always entertains and never bored!!!! The beds are so comfortable and bunk room perfect for the kids!!!! We loved it!!!!! Thank you again!!!! Sue and Jeff"

reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations!
reviews.comment: "This property over exceeded all expectations. Jen was fantastic to deal with in the lead-up to our stay. The home and backyard took our breath away and included every amenity we could ever need for a wonderful and fun weekend. We'll definitely be back!"

reviews.title: Amazing stay at Jaguar Estate!
reviews.comment: "The home is beautiful, plenty of space and parking for everybody, the grounds are amazing, both pools are great, the patio with the TV was great for watching football in the great weather and the volleyball and pickleball courts are awesome. The house is set up perfect for groups to relax and play games all day and night in the game room, its like having your own resort! The house is close enough to Palm Desert to get to great restaurants and doordash for whatever you may need for your stay. Our group absolutely loved the stay and we will definitely be coming back to the Jaguar Estate sometime soon. Jen was a great host and very responsive to the few minor issues we had with the property (the neighbors sprinkler broke and flooded the pickleball court) she sent somebody over ASAP to get it cleaned up and she went above and beyond to accommodate our group."

reviews.title: Amazing House & Activities
reviews.comment: "The house is just as advertised and is perfect! If you love activities, there isn’t a better house. Inside is wonderful too and the master bedroom is massive! Thanks again to the great and attentive hosts."

reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.comment: "The house and the entire property were as advertised. If you're looking for a great place to have a relaxing stay this is it. We had a group of 12 and everyone was comfortable and as relaxed as can be. The Pickleball, Pools and the Golf Setup were amazing. 10 out of 10"

reviews.title: Dreamy
reviews.comment: "This place is the best place we’ve booked thus far! It felt like a resort. The place was nice and clean with everything we needed and more. The host was very friendly and very responsive. This home is so dreamy, that many of my friends messaged me after seeing photos I posted on social media, to ask for the booking so they could book their next vacation. 10/10 would highly recommend! Thank you again for sharing your home with us!"

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.comment: "Jaguar Estates was an amazing property, very private and lots to do with your family and friends. The location was very clean and instructions to access the property/amenities was simple to follow. Also, the host Jen is very responsive and accommodating with request to make my vacation experience the best. I highly recommend this location and can’t wait for another vacation opportunity to visit Jaguar Estates again :-)"

reviews.title: Great House and great service!
reviews.comment: "It was a fantastic experience for us to have our kids and grandkids under the same roof! The TRAVLR support was very easy to work with and very responsive when we had questions or needs. Thank you!"

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.comment: "This estate was definitely a great stay. I loved the 2 pools and how much space it had on the inside as well."

reviews.title: Very well appointed
reviews.comment: "Very well appointed, clean and secure property. The pools are amazing and very private. We thoroughly enjoyed our impromptu weekend trip! Will stay again and I have NEVER said that about another property!"

reviews.title: What a treat!
reviews.comment: "What a treat! Our stay at Jaguar Estate was dreamy. The house has been renovated and decorated impeccably, but also made us feel comfortable and at home. The property management was extremely responsive and helpful, even immediately bringing us several bags of ice when we discovered that the freezer bin was empty. Beds and pillows were very comfortable, which is something that I think a lot of rental properties skimp on. There were a plethora of towels, both for the bathrooms and for pool use. Speaking of the pool… excuse me… POOLS. Because if one private pool isn’t enough for you, don’t worry… Jaguar Estate has TWO. And between those, the pickle ball court, the sand volleyball court, the soccer field, the putting green, and the game room there was more than enough to keep our three families (including 10 kids and young adults) well entertained. We never left the property for the four days of our stay. Why would we? The kitchen was extremely well stocked with gadgets, serving vessels, and dinnerware. Our only complaint was that while the pots and pans provided were very nice quality, nothing was big enough to cook for 16 people. We had to use three small pots to cook enough pasta for all of us, and even with those each pot was overfilled. If you’re driving in and want to make large dishes, you may want to bring your own pots and pans. But overall this was a glorious stay and we most certainly will be back. We are already talking about our next visit!"

reviews.title: Top Notch
reviews.comment: "Everything was top notch"

reviews.title: Great Property!
reviews.comment: "We loved the property; the pictures are spot on and the outdoor activities were perfect for our grand daughters as well as the adults. It was spacious and yet felt intimate at the same time. We love to cook and the kitchen has everything you need to make gourmet meals. Great property and great communication, thank you!"

reviews.title: Stunning Home and Property!
reviews.comment: The home and property are gorgeous, well appointed and in very new condition. The property exceeds the beautiful pictures on this site and will not disappoint! The check-in and check out was seamless with great communication throughout our stay. The location was secluded and quiet (a very positive surprise). We will be back!

reviews.title: Amazing Home!
reviews.comment: "Amazing home and attentive host! I will be staying here again."

reviews.title: Amazing Space
reviews.comment: "A fantastic property with enough activities and amenities to keep our large group busy for the whole weekend. Really an amazing space that we'll look forward to getting back to in the near future. Great for large families or weekends away with friends."

reviews.title: Lovely Stay
reviews.comment: "Beautiful home, great amenities, very relaxing, lovely views. Great getaway home."

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "Everything was great. Had a great stay with family ! Thank you !"

reviews.title: Truly Amazing
reviews.comment: "Fantastic airbnb. We will be back. Very comfortable bedding which in our experience is hard to find. The backyard and pool area were also a highlight as well as how responsive Jen was!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "An absolutely gorgeous property, perfect for our group of 12. Seamless self check-in and check-out process. Well stocked kitchen for cooking, comfortable beds, beautiful restrooms and high ceilings. We enjoyed the salt water pool, the outdoor “mist feature”, ping pong table and pool table. The master bedroom was stunning, included a massive ensuite and walk in closet. We appreciated every small detail from communication to accommodation and can’t wait to be back."

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay!
reviews.comment: "Beautiful home and an amazing stay! The house was much bigger than it looked in the photos and had plenty of room for multiple families. We spent most of our time in the pool and playing pool, and our kids had the best time. The location was perfect, close to golf and super convenient for Coachella. The home was spotless, well-stocked, and had everything we needed. The best part was the service. Communication was excellent from start to finish, and they even accommodated a last-minute late checkout, which we really appreciated. I've booked through management companies before and often felt nickeled and dimed, but this company was the complete opposite, friendly, professional, and genuinely focused on making sure we had a great stay. We would absolutely book with them again. One of the best Airbnb experiences we've had, and we can't wait to come back. The outdoor space was fantastic, the beds were comfortable, and every detail was thoughtfully taken care of."

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.comment: "Our stay was excellent in every way. Can’t wait to come back."

reviews.title: Enjoyable Stay!
reviews.comment: "LOVED our stay at Legends!!! The house was beautiful, clean, looked just like the pictures. The host was flexible and let us check in early. The backyard was amazing- pool, fire place, misters, plenty of lounge chairs and umbrellas. Would love to stay here again and highly recommend!:"

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.comment: "Our stay in La Quinta was amazing! The house was beautiful and the spa backyard was the best! Will definitely stay again."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "This was our 3rd time staying at the property and we thoroughly enjoyed it again.The host/communication was excellent and prompt. The Crumble cookies as a welcome were a big hit with my teenagers!House was stocked perfectly and beautiful as ever.If I may make one suggestion, it would be to add more trash bins in the master bathroom (under each sink), new bath towels and new pool towels. They are getting a bit thin and worn looking."

reviews.title: Absolutely Perfect!
reviews.comment: "The house and location was great! Outdoor patio and hot tub was perfect. The house was equipped with all essentials and amenities. Great property!"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Amenities were as described and communication was very good."

reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.comment: "The house was great... very roomy and comfortable. The host was very responsive and helpful. Would recommend a stay here for sure!"

reviews.title: Perfect Stay
reviews.comment: "Great place for great family time, indoors and out! From the pool to the pool table…PERFECT"

reviews.title: Well Equipped
reviews.comment: "Every possible pan, dish, glass available for easy day to day meals along with special holiday festivities. Questions and concerns promptly communicated and reassured all is well with clear, prompt communication. Comfortable area to sit with quality beddings"

reviews.title: Great Home
reviews.comment: "We had a lovely time with our family in this home. It is a great home for a large family and very comfortable. Jen, was very responsive when we had any questions. We will definitely be back."

reviews.title: Will be back!
reviews.comment: "We had a great stay; house was large and comfortable - a lot of room to spread out as a family. would stay again."

reviews.title: Everything we needed
reviews.comment: "Jen was an excellent host! Her check-in and check-out instructions were incredibly detailed, making both processes effortless. She also checked in with us after our arrival and again before our departure to ensure we had everything we needed for a great stay. The house itself was beautiful. The kitchen was fully stocked with every glass, plate, and utensil we needed for the weekend, and there was plenty of space for our group to relax in the common areas. The backyard with the pool, spa, and fireplace quickly became our favorite spot to spend time while staying at Legends. It was also a super convenient drive to the PGA WEST courses we played during our trip. Thanks again, Jen! We hope to return!"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Beautiful home, the backyard was the best part ,came fully equipped with everything we needed. The host was great ! Highly recommended!"

reviews.title: 5-Stars
reviews.comment: "great stay. would love to come back!"

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.comment: "Celebrated my 50th b day with some friends for the weekend. Couldnt of think of a more perfect house to celebrate in. Had all the amentities we needed. Very spacious, clean, and beautiful. My friends were in awe of the place. Jen the host was very nice and replied righ away with my request. Thank you Jen for letting us stay at your place. Would definitely recommend it to others and would come back again!"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "I booked this home to celebrate my daughter and her best friend’s 16th birthday with their friends. Jen was super responsive with answering questions and even helped us with a surprise balloon delivery for the girls! The home was spacious and and fit all of us with plenty of room to spare. The outdoor area perfect and the girls loved the pool and the ping-pong table! The home was absolutely perfect and made it for a memorable weekend for the birthday girls. I highly recommend!"

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.comment: "This property was perfect for our trip. We had 3 families and plenty of space! The kitchen was fully stocked, and my only regret is we didn't stay longer!"

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.comment: "Beautiful place! Everything was just as described and as shown in photos. A very nice place for a relaxing getaway."

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.comment: "Perfect Desert Getaway! We had an amazing weekend at this beautiful home! The house itself was absolutely stunning—thoughtfully designed, spotless, and incredibly comfortable. The host was wonderful to communicate with—very responsive, friendly, and attentive to every detail, which made our stay feel extra special. We always love visiting the desert, and this home made it even more memorable. We will definitely be back! Highly recommend to anyone looking for a relaxing and stylish escape."

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.comment: "The house was nicely decorated and in a lovely neighborhood. Paige was responsive to questions and concerns that we had."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Wonderful property and very comfortable for all of our adult children and spouses."

reviews.title: Lovely Home
reviews.comment: "The house is lovely and the kitchen well appointed with all the things you’ll need."

reviews.title: Perfect Space
reviews.comment: "Jen’s house was perfect for our week with family. Everyone had their own space to relax and also to come together to hang out. The kitchen was well stocked with cookware and flatware, plenty of clean bathrooms, and the backyard was very peaceful. Would definitely stay again."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Great stay. There were 7 adults from Illinois and Texas. We do a trip together every year. Enjoyed the pool and house. Terrific weather this week."

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.comment: "When we arrived they had the TVs showing the Super Bowl. So thoughtful! And that was everything about the stay , it had everything we needed . Pool was warm and amazing . Yard being fenced in was wonderful with the dog. The views of the course and the mountains were amazing. We will be back for sure . It was perfect"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Opened the garage early for us so we could assemble bikes and ride on day 1. Well stocked kitchen. Clean and comfortable. Beautiful backyard and hot tub."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Great service…"

reviews.title: Will be back!
reviews.comment: "Property was great…will definitely stay here again! Weather was quite cold, so golfing not optimal, but the house made the trip fun!"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Property was great…will definitely stay here again!Weather was quite cold, so golfing not optimal, but the house made the trip fun!"

reviews.title: Incredible Stay
reviews.comment: "Great house. Awesome hosts. Incredible stay. Recommended. Thank you for having us!!"

reviews.title: Clean & Well-Appointed
reviews.comment: "We had a great stay at this very clean and well-appointed home. Loved the pool and peaceful view of the course, walking the quiet neighborhood in the morning and close to The Quarry where we were golfing."

reviews.title: Beautiful Home
reviews.comment: "Checkin and communication with TRAVLR was excellent- very responsive. The home is in a beautiful gate guarded community. All questions and inquiries were answered promptly. The home is expansive that includes different areas for entertaining. Our group enjoyed the bar area, pool table and fireplace. We were able to enjoy an in home spa day with massage tables set up in the master bedroom and bathroom. The kitchen and bar area well stocked with barware and cooking and entertaining dishes. Thank you."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "The house is a wonderful property inside and out."

reviews.title: Perfect Location
reviews.comment: "We booked our stay as a getaway with some employees & friends! It was the perfect location, the house is beautiful, lots of space. Great location to get to everything as well. Outdoor setting has beautiful views as well."

reviews.title: The Perfect House!
reviews.comment: "This was our 2nd time staying at Jen’s house! We will be back again! This is house is so perfect! It’s beautiful, spacious and clean!! We love this house!"

reviews.title: Even Better in Person!
reviews.comment: "We decided to book a last minute trip just hours before our arrival. Jen was extremely communicative and proactive with such short notice. We arrived and the house was even better in person than in the photos which is rare. We had four adults and five kids with us and there was more than enough space, we didn’t even have to use the fifth bedroom as the other rooms were so large and well appointed. Beautiful backyard and plenty of space for pool time, relaxing, BBQing and more. We had a great time and will definitely stay here again! Jen and her team were fantastic hosts!"

reviews.title: Very Well Maintained
reviews.comment: "We absolutely loved Legends home. It was clean and very well maintained. The beds were super comfy. The pros are a lot. The kitchen was equipped with everything. The house had a great flow. The master bedroom was its own quarters. The cons was the fifth bedroom was not accessible to the house. You had to enter from outside by the driveway. I definitely will come back and stay there. We loved the home."

reviews.title: Highly Recommended!
reviews.comment: "Great property and even better host! Very responsive, we reached out about some minimal issue and it was fixed in less than 30 minutes. Highly recommended!"

reviews.title: Perfect Family Trip
reviews.comment: "The property is located in a safe and quiet community. Perfect location and house for a family get together. The layout was perfect for us, 5 adults and 4 children. The house is decorated in good taste and the amenities are very nice, great pool, spa, ping pong table, pool table, etc. If you are looking for a party house, this house is not for you. If you are looking for a house to rest, have family time and enjoy each others company, this is the perfect house. The check in and check out was seamless. We felt at home throughout our stay. We never left the property. The kitchen is well equipped to prepare your meals, however if you want to order food, there are several options to order from. We highly recommend this property."

reviews.title: Dream Come True!
reviews.comment: "My family and I had a fantastic stay. The property was like a dream come true for us. They provided us with graduation balloons for my daughter which was a wonderful surprise. The pool and hot tub was great. Thank you for providing us with such a wonderful property!"

reviews.title: First Class
reviews.comment: "This home is everything one expects for a first class home. Perfect for our family reunion of 8 adults and 4 children. The house is in perfect condition including a complete inventory of kitchen equipment, sharp knives, glassware, etc. the bedrooms are well appointed and spacious. The pool and hot tub works exactly as expected. The staff was terrific from initial rental steps through thoughtful communication when we arrived and during our visit. We give this a 10+ rating."

reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.comment: "The house exceeded our expectations. Lots of space for 6 adults and 2 infants. The backyard was beautiful overlooking the golf course and mountains. Property manager (Jen) replied within minutes to any questions we had. We would definitely come back."

reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.comment: "Had the most peaceful weekend! The pictures really did look like the home. The help was responsive and helpful. Absolutely a 10/10"

reviews.title: Lovely Stay!
reviews.comment: "Had a very lovely and smooth stay! Thank you Jen:) would definitely love to come back"

reviews.title: Highly Recommend!!
reviews.comment: "We had five couples celebrating a milestone birthday. This five-bedroom home was perfect! Easily accommodated our group. Location was fantastic for the golfers in our group, and backyard worked well for non-golfers to relax poolside in the sun. Management responded quickly to all our queries. Highly highly recommend! We will be back!!!"

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Great place. Great location."

reviews.title: Guest Review
reviews.comment: "Our stay was excellent and we can’t wait to return!"

reviews.title: Fabulous Getaway!
reviews.comment: "We stayed with a group of moms and daughters and it was fabulous. We are already trying to figure out when we are booking the next stay here!"

reviews.title: Great Location!
reviews.comment: "We had owned a home in Rancho Mirage for 20 years This area was a lot better for us. Being from Alaska the weather was awesome"

reviews.title: Everything You Need!
reviews.comment: "Overall this residence was completely perfect for our short mini family reunion. Good location, very clean and well stocked with everything you need. We had a small issue with the outdoor grill but management was on top of it immediately. Bravo! If anything I am not a fan of memory foam mattresses but it didn't bother the others. Having said that I would rent this home again. Great outdoor space."

reviews.title: Loved Every Moment
reviews.comment: "This property is phenomenal! We shared a long, relaxing family retreat poolside & had the best time!! House is extremely spacious & well laid out and the great room/kitchen/billiard room is perfect for game night & family time! The bedrooms were lovely and all the beds/bedding were incredibly high quality!! We did lots of cooking and the kitchen was very well stocked with beautiful dishes, cooking necessities, no stone left unturned! My niece, who is an interior decorator kept commenting on how high quality the furnishings & details on this house are. The outdoor pool/spa/fire pit/ ping pong table was phenomenal! We thoroughly the spacious outdoor amenities…lots of places to enjoy your morning coffee, while enjoying the gorgeous views of the mountains. Jen was incredibly attentive & responsive to our needs prior to our stay and during! We loved every moment we spent at this beautiful property and cannot wait to make this a yearly vacay spot for our family!"

reviews.title: Great Home!
reviews.comment: "Stayed in late Sept./early Oct. with friends (four couples) for a golf and relaxation get away. The house accommodated our group well. We appreciated having king beds in 4 of the rooms. The master was HUGE. The other three en-suite bedrooms were nice size, bathrooms were small, but adequate. We enjoyed the common areas, well appointed kitchen, bar, pool table (which we used quite a bit) and also made use of the nice yard, pool, Jacuzzi, ping pong table and fire place/bowls. The golf courses we chose to play and restaurants in old town La Quinta were relatively close. El Paseo was a little further away, but do-able. The house manager was very responsive and took care of our needs in a timely manner. Over all as advertised and a great home to rent in Palm Desert."

reviews.title: Beautiful Views
reviews.comment: "We had such a wonderful stay! The house was exactly as described. So clean, beautiful views and Jen was so easy to work with. We look forward to staying at this one again!"

reviews.title: Can't wait to come back!
reviews.comment: "We booked this amazing house with two other families before summer ended and kids heading back to school. It was truly a fabulous experience. The house was just as pictured. It was well built, well designed and well maintained. Very clean and great energy throughout the house. The layout was great for entertaining all our families. The kitchen, living area, and bar area were perfect for eating and drinking and hanging out with a big group. The backyard was perfect for swimming all day and barbecuing meals along with a fireplace for smores in the evening. We all loved it so much we want to come back to this same house each year. The property manager was super responsive throughout the whole experience. Whether through text or through the VRBO app, I was always able to connect with her. Highly recommend!"

reviews.title: Amazing Home!
reviews.comment: "This home was amazing! Clean, spacious, well equipped & everything was functional! Check in was a breeze. Jen was a great communicator. There was a very handy instructional book available so any questions I had were answered there. Pool was great and and instructions were self explanatory unlike some homes where you have to call to contact the host to make adjustments. Home looks just just as pictured. Was very quiet & private. We used food and grocery delivery services and had no issues with security at gate. I did have to describe my car that was in the driveway for deliveries as the address number was covered by a bougainvillea bush and a bit hard to find but that wasn’t much of an issue. Everything over all was pretty easy breezy. We would definitely stay again!"

reviews.title: Perfect Place
reviews.comment: "The place was perfect for our trip to PS. We enjoyed the trip so much i think we are going to stay again in the same place in the next weeks! Thanks Jen!"

reviews.title: Beautiful Home!
reviews.comment: "Beautiful home with a great pool. With August heat we could enjoy the pool in the evening and were able to see a shooting star. Pool was quite warm and I recommend not to get heated pool option if there in 100 degree weather. Note that pool lights are turned off at 11pm. They kept tuning off every hour starting at 9:30pm the first couple night and we had to keep contacting the host - they were responsive most of the time. I recommend proactively asking that they keep lights on between the hours you plan to use pool in the evening. Accommodations were great - beds were comfy and home was comfortable with AC. We were thankful for the board games as we were traveling with young kids. We also really enjoyed the awesome pool table near the living room. Showers always came to temperature quickly even when most of our group was using showers at the same time. Will definitely consider this property when I come back to La Quinta. Kudos to the hosts for making the property family friendly."

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.comment: "Thank you! The house, instructions and everything was perfect. We really enjoyed our stay! Thanks again!"

reviews.title: Incredible!
reviews.comment: "The pictures do not do it justice how beautiful, spacious and well put together everything is! The space was incredible to host a family girls trip. The master is large enough that we had three masseuses doing in house massages and two of which done at the same time in the master bedroom. Contacting the property management was so easy and efficient! We absolutely look forward to staying again! The only thing I would mention is that we didn’t know about no outdoor music. Understandable since you’re on a gold course but we were bit confused since quiet hours said 9pm-8am so we thought that was it. We made it work though and loved every minute of staying here!"

reviews.title: Fantastic Property!
reviews.comment: "This property was fantastic! I stayed here with my 3 children and 5 grandchildren...it was an opportunity to all be together under one roof. The owner's have truly thought of everything...we didn't have to leave the property! The pool, ping pong, billiards, putting green(the list goes on) made for a really fun time for all. I highly recommend this property...perfectly suited for family fun and a beautiful view as well!"

reviews.title: Hands Down the Best
reviews.comment: "This was hands down the best Vrbo we have ever stayed at. The property was exactly as described and incredibly clean. The location was beautiful and serene on the golf course. Plenty to do between the pool, ping pong table and billiards table. The house was located in a beautiful community which was perfect for our morning runs. The manager, Jen and her team were very responsive to any questions that we had and they even offered a service where they received our instacart order and put it away for us before our arrival. I look forward to staying at this property again!"

reviews.title: Great Time
reviews.comment: "We had a great time!"

reviews.title: Luxurious Family Fun in the Sun
reviews.comment: "Everything you can imagine and then some. We originally booked for a family of 11, but 4 could not make it. They missed out staying at this amazing property. The pool, spa and outdoor dining were most relaxing. We loved the fire pots that lit up the pool area and the endless seating options surrounding the outdoor space. There was ample room for all. Kids were disappointed that the arcade game was broken which was a key element for this rental. The management was very responsive even to my silly questions and they did send two people over to try to fix the game, but apparently there was no fixing it. reviews.title: Every room has a billion dollar view
reviews.comment: "I’m not even sure where to start, the Dream House is exactly that, a dream! When you first roll up you’ll see an architectural masterpiece, the house is stunning both outside and in. Every room has a billion dollar view and the master bedroom is in a category by itself, I’ve never seen something so beautiful. The house has everything you could possible want, games for the kids, pool toys, arcade, ping pong, pool table, a next level grill/BBQ area, TVs inside and out, plenty of lounge areas, and so much more. If you need anything, the caretakers of the house would respond quickly and get you whatever you could possibly dream of. We had a chef come in and make us possibly the greatest tacos I’ve had in a long long time. I’d have to say my favorite part of the house might be the pool. The views while sitting in the pool are next level with no words to describe how perfect it is. You won’t go wrong staying at the Dream House, I can’t wait to go back."

reviews.title: This house is truly one-of-a-kind!
reviews.comment: "We absolutely LOVED our stay at the Dream House. This house is truly one-of-a-kind, from it's jaw-dropping views, to its top-of-the-line amenities and impeccable architectural and interior design. It's the type of house you are amazed with as soon as you walk in, and then continually commenting about during your stay. We loved it so much that when others from our party went for an outing to the zoo, we opted to stay at the house to enjoy all it had to offer. We loved that the entire wall-to-wall glass facing the view opened with a push of a button to create a true indoor-outdoor living space. We spent most of our time at the lovely pool & spa, cocktails in hand. The pool was gorgeous, clean, had a large baja shelf; there were ample lounge chairs and umbrellas for shade. We enjoyed most of our meals at the covered outdoor dining table. On the other side of the living space there's an awesome game room/gym/bar area for intermittent breaks from the pool/sun. The gym area even has a Peloton! The kids enjoyed the game room, especially the arcade machine that had every game we could think of on it. The kitchen is beautiful and fully equipped with everything we needed. The coffee/espresso machine was a Jura which made a delicious cup of coffee straight from whole beans. We also used the well-equipped outdoor kitchen (again, with awesome views) to BBQ some steaks and chicken. The huge master bedroom is INSANE, with it's own outdoor deck, breathtaking views, huge bathroom and walk-in closet! We stayed in one of the other bedrooms, which all have en-suite bathrooms with the softest towels I've ever felt, large showers, high-end products and a true spa-like feel. The beds were incredibly comfortable (from mattresses to bedding), which is often an afterthought but so important on vacation - we all slept so well! We'll definitely be back - in fact, just last night, my husband and I were looking at dates to return with some friends in the coming months. Can't wait!"

reviews.title: This is an incredible house
reviews.comment: "We stayed at the dream house with some couple friends and our kids and didn't leave the property! There is no need to with the abundance of activities offered at the house. Our kids (8F and 6M) had an incredible time swimming, shooting hoops on Pop-a-Shot, playing video games (they have a machine with 1,000s of games on it), chasing and catching lizards and of course a vast majority of the time, swimming in the luxurious pool and hot tub. We had pizza delivered one night (which came quickly and easily, which was a concern of ours because the house is so private and high on the hill) and they arranged for a private chef the other night which was affordable and delicious. The house has stunning views from every room. My wife and I spent a majority of our time lounging in the pool with a cocktail. All the bedrooms have incredible views and the master is comically large and insane - views, massive bathroom, sitting room, lounge area, etc. The entire first floor is perfectly balanced with the living area on the view/pool side and the game room/bar on the mountain side. We enjoyed the game room a lot. Played pool, basketball and even got the ping pong table out to smoke my buddy a few times. Spent the evenings in the hot tub and by the pool listening to nature sounds and relaxing. We will 1,000 percent go back. This is an incredible house that truly stands out as one of the nicest I've ever stayed at."

reviews.title: The Dream Vacation
reviews.comment: All the amenities necessary to not have to leave the house was provided. Some of the more unexpected treats was the Sauna, The peloton in the Master bedroom, overhead showers in every bathroom, and the amount of activities available for entertaining. The option to call a personal chief was provided. There was state of the art EVERYTHING for which instructions were provided. There was a variety of entertainment and if that was not enough you could always go for a swim or relax in the jacuzzi. I appreciated not having to forgo my workouts. Although, I did not work out, the option was there and that made me feel good! Lol My children, all girls, ages 5, 8, and 12 had a ball. They mostly enjoyed the pool. That being said, I would not recommend this place for people with small children if you cannot keep very close watch on them or if they cannot swim. We kept them down stairs when we were down stairs and they pretty much put themselves to bed after swimming most of day. It was very easy to respect the quiet rules after 9pm as lowering the music and the lighting at this time made for a more relaxing atmosphere. This is NOT the place to go if you want to party! This is a relaxing, rejuvenating, taking in the views kind of get away! The house was just as stated in the name, “A Dream!”

reviews.comment: "We had an amazing stay at Villa Bella House with TRAVLR. The attention to detail throughout the home was outstanding, and the thoughtfully designed custom architecture made it incredibly comfortable for our group of four families. One feature we especially appreciated was the detached bedroom and bathroom with its own private entrance—it was perfect for the family member who enjoyed staying out late at the casino, allowing them to come and go without disturbing anyone else. The host was also very responsive and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. The game room was a huge hit, and we had an incredible time watching the FIFA World Cup together. Even with a group of 14 people, the spacious single-story layout never felt crowded. The backyard was clean, beautifully maintained, and offered plenty of room for everyone to relax. The pool and rock waterfall were a favorite with the kids, who spent all day enjoying. Picture do not do justice. Villa Bella House exceeded all of our expectations. We’ve previously stayed at Jaguar Estate, but after this experience, Villa Bella House will definitely be our first choice for future trips."

reviews.title: More beautiful than the photos
reviews.comment: "This place is as great as you are hoping it is. More beautiful than the photos. More comfortable than you've had an Airbnb be in the past. My family and I stayed NINE nights, so I should know! We used Instacart to stock the kitchen in the first few days. The kitchen is well stocked with everything you'll need, it's not the fanciest pots but it works and they all have lids. The massive island in the kitchen is a real feature, giving you plenty of space to spread out, cook, hang out and eat. The sunken bar is a really nice feature, I don't think we used it to its fullest but it's really classy. The most obvious feature of the house is its massive great room. You can see it in the photos, but it allows people to gather in multiple spaces while still feeling like you are "together". Many of the houses in the complex don't even have a pool, let alone a pool with a lounging deck as nice as this one, complete with a TV in the outdoor cooking space. The signs and instructions were very clear they do NOT want amplified music outside, so we kept it quiet. The next door neighbor was doing quite a bit of yardwork, but we just went inside when it was noisy. The swan visited us many times and became the subject of many memorable photos. She even got in the pool with us!! Be careful though: swans bite! The master bedroom is the size of my first house. Unreal... and I slept in every morning despite being a very picky sleeper. Super comfy bed and bedding. And you can make the room really dark mid-day and watch movies if that's your thing. The master bath has one of the best showers I've ever been in. The floor in there is really slick, I wouldn't want my elderly parents in there with their feet wet, but we made it work. My only regret is I never got in the gigantic inset tub. The garage is massive, so plenty of space for you and your party to park. You cannot use the golf cart, but that's ok. We're not golfers so it wasn't an issue. We did work with the owner to bring in a caterer/private chef, which was a really nice way to make an event out of the holiday. The owners have on-site property management that offered housekeeping, brought us additional dishwasher soap pellets and and came by with a pie for Thanksgiving. All in all, it was a very memorable and luxurious family vacation. A special way to connect and make memories with the people we love."

A grocery store very close by makes grocery shopping easy. The game room is a blast. We even rented a pool gate from a local company as we had little kids. This was a HUGE plus so they littles weren't able to jump in the pool without adult supervision. Would love to come back to this house."

reviews.title: Perfect Getaway!
reviews.comment: "Jen's home was the perfect getaway. The house was clean, had great amenities and was perfect space to accommodate a group. Super easy check in, very comfortable and had a great backyard! Overall amazing house and experience!"

reviews.title: Exceeded All Expectations
reviews.comment: "I never expect a house to live up to the website photos. This house exceeded all expectations and was exactly as described/pictured. There's plenty of space, and every last detail is taken care of. We had an amazing time and are already talking about the next reunion in this wonderful location."

reviews.title: THE BEST!!
reviews.comment: "This house is absolutely STUNNING! More than enough room to comfortable accommodate a large group, excellent outdoor space, beautiful home! Jen and her team were very quick with answering any questions we had!!"

reviews.title: Just Wonderful!
reviews.comment: "Amazing house and amenities!"

reviews.title: Perfect Place!
reviews.comment: "I've had the pleasure of staying at one of Jen's other properties in the past, and this time was not any different. Kamila, the House Manager, was easy to contact and answered all of my questions promptly. The house was spacious and the amenities were top notch. My guests and I had a great time utilizing the pool and game room. The drive way was spacious and provided ample room to park, even with large vehicles. I celebrated my birthday with my friends and family and the house was the perfect place to host for the occasion. I would totally stay here again!"

reviews.title: All in the Details!
reviews.comment: "The pictures don’t do this place justice! We were oooh-ing and ah-ing upon arrival. The rooms were beautiful. The space was perfect for our large group. The pool was ideal. We especially enjoyed the fire pit by the pool and the corn hole game! These little touches made our stay so much fun. We will be back!"

reviews.title: Easy for Us
reviews.comment: "Communication, check-in, information was all very smooth and easily accessible."

reviews.title: Inside and Out
reviews.comment: "Great place!"

reviews.title: Beautiful space.
reviews.comment: "Very Comfortable bedding, amazing pool, very private. Thank you."

reviews.title: So many AMAZING things
reviews.comment: "So many AMAZING things, it's hard to know where to start!! Check in was a breeze and Jen was very responsive before and during our stay. The house was absolutely breath taking - the pictures don't do it justice!! When we arrived, the house was so welcoming - all the lights were on, music was playing, the fireplace was on and all the lights in the backyard. Truly a fairy tale birthday for myself and my guests! We were able to host dinner for 18 one evening comfortably and the kitchen had everything we needed. The kids loved the game room and it was so nice to relax on the back patio with everyone after dinner. The beds were comfortable and there were plenty of fresh towels for the bathrooms and the pool. I really love the open floor plan that allowed me to visit with everyone even while in the kitchen. We highly recommend Jen's place for anyone with a group or those who are planning to entertain!"

reviews.title: We'll be back!
reviews.comment: "Beautiful place that was perfectly decorated. Modern but warm and cozy, even though the place was huge! Bigger than we thought from the pictures. Beds were comfy. The master bedroom was just amazing. I texted our house manager to ask if there were a pitcher and glasses for us to make sangrias and she bought a sangria mixer set with fruits to greet us! Excellent and thoughtful hospitality! The game room was an excellent addition but we didn't play in there too much because it was way too warm (the lighting heated up the room) and opening the garage doors would have made it too loud of the neighbors. Only downfall was one of our showers wasn't working. Kamila, our house manager sent someone to fix it but he couldn't get it done so was going to come back but never did. This didn't bother us too much because we just shared the other showers. Just a slight, not major, inconvenience. What would have made our weekend trip perfect was the ability to check out late. Too bad the house is so popular that it was booked the day we checked out. We will totally come back for sure!!"

reviews.title: Heated Salt Water Pool was my Favorite!
reviews.comment: "This house was perfect! We had a girls weekend to celebrate a 40th birthday and the house and amenities lived up to all expectations. The pool was perfect and we were very happy to have it heated, also the salt water is a great touch then you don’t come out of the pool covered in chemicals. Jen and her team were very responsive before, during and after the trip with any questions we had for them. We will definitely be back for another weekend away."

reviews.title: Perfect from the start!
reviews.comment: "The house was very clean and ready, with music playing, fireplace lit, pool running, upon our arrival. The house was above expectation."

reviews.title: Never needed to leave the property :)
reviews.comment: "The house is beautiful and in a very nice neighborhood. The property is very expansive and private so you really feel like you can spread out. It's further from the Palm Springs area where we usually go but the value is worth it for big groups. There is much to do on the property, between the game room, the entertainment screens in each room and the BBQ and pool, we never left for the 3 nights we stayed. If you don't mind staying outside of Palm Springs I would definitely recommend this property."

reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.comment: "It's a great house definitely worth it what you pay for."

reviews.title: Great Indio Destination
reviews.comment: "Jen's place was the perfect home for our weekend in Indio. The accommodations and features were perfect for our close friends that stayed with us. Would definitely stay again!"

reviews.title: This house was incredible
reviews.comment: "This house was incredible. It comfortably slept a group of 15 guests and everyone enjoyed the amenities the house provided. The house and pool were larger than we expected. The location was near golf courses and had a grocery store nearby which was very convenient when entertaining a larger group. Would love to rent this house again and Jen was a fantastic host!"

reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.comment: "The house is relatively secluded in a quiet neighborhood and makes for a beautiful gathering home. First, the communication with the owners was great - they even stopped by the first evening to check in and make sure we were comfortable. The home is absolutely beautiful. Many rooms, most with their own bathrooms, large open living area/dining room floor plan, and lovely pool and backyard. We wanted to spend the weekend with our close 13-14 friends and family cooking large meals, bbqing, and spending time in the pool and it was perfect."

reviews.title: Beautiful House
reviews.comment: "This is a truly beautiful and wonderful house!!! My girlfriends and I had such a lovely weekend! We could not get over how beautiful and nice the house is! It was perfectly accommodating for all of us! There was everything we needed there and Jen was extremely informative and quick to respond! I highly recommend! We may make this an annual thing!!!"

reviews.title: Very Nice House
reviews.comment: "Very nice house, everybody liked the swimming pool."

reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.comment: "This place has thought of everything! The house is incredibly comfortable and beautiful. The beds, appliances, and amenities are exceptional. The pool, bbq, and game room make this place the perfect spot to hang out with friends and family. Jen was a great host and answered my many questions quickly. We rented the space for my husbands 30th bday and it was perfect!"

reviews.title: Great Location!
reviews.comment: "Beautiful home! Comfortably slept 16 people with plenty of space. Jen was a great host and was very quick to respond to any questions we had. Would definitely recommend for your vacation."

reviews.title: Go-To Vacation Home
reviews.comment: "This is our go-to Vacation Home in the desert! Great backyard for entertaining and tons of games and amenities for adults and kids to enjoy! Everything in the home is brand new and extremely clean. We will definitely be back again and are already planning our next trip to this private desert estate! Thank you Jen for being an amazing host to me and my family for a special Father's Day weekend! We are excited to come back!"

reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.comment: "We just got home from a fabulous 3 night stay at Jen's gorgeous house to celebrate my husband's 40th birthday. We had 14 guests, and everyone kept raving about how immaculate and nicely decorated the home was. The pool was plenty big for the amount of guests we had, and the outside property was perfect for bocce ball, corn hole, etc. The game room was amazing for ping pong, darts, shuffle board, and pool. We even hired a taco bar and enjoyed an in-home massage therapist. All were fabulous and were icing on the cake to a relaxing and enjoyable weekend. We certainly would recommend this house to anyone and we look forward to renting it again soon!"

reviews.title: Elegant & Immaculate
reviews.comment: "Planned a girls weekend. The house was more amazing than we thought with plenty of space!!! The pool was perfect and heated for us. The grill was natural gas so we didn't have to worry about charcoal or propane. The rooms were decorated very elegantly and the cleanliness was immaculate. Great place to stay! Highly recommend!!!"

reviews.title: New. Enormous. Stunning.
reviews.comment: "This location is absolutely amazing. Everything is new, the rooms are enormous and the backyard is stunning. If you have the opportunity to stay at this location, DO IT!"

reviews.title: Far Beyond my Expectations
reviews.comment: "Jen and her husband were so accommodating. The place was so clean and had all kinds of accommodations. The decor and amenities were far beyond my expectations. Thank you for one of the best stays I've had."

reviews.title: Best Vacation Home Ever!
reviews.comment: "This is the best vacation home I have ever stayed at! The beautifully appointed home had seven gorgeous bedrooms, a game room and backyard with a beautiful salt water pool, swim up bar, Jacuzzi, citrus trees, fire pit and furniture provided a great venue for a relaxing few days in the desert. The hosts were very responsive which is great if we had any questions. This is complete resort style living and we thoroughly enjoyed all of the amenities they had to offer. We can’t wait to come back. Thanks Jen and Spencer! Highly recommended!"

reviews.title: Upscale Furnishings and Fantastic Amenities
reviews.comment: "We loved our stay in Indio! There were 10 of us staying here and everyone felt comfortable. This house was beautiful, with upscale furnishings and fantastic amenities. The hosts were extremely welcoming and the place was spotless when we checked in. This house has an amazing backyard, we loved hanging outside in the evenings. Thanks Jen, can't wait to come back!"

reviews.title: Our own 5-star Resort
reviews.comment: "The Lawrence Estate, managed by Jen, exceeded all expectations. The home has 7 beautifully appointed bedrooms, including a private casita. We rented the estate for a company retreat and it turned out to be the perfect place to brainstorm, work and relax. They provided a game room - a great place for our staff to bond. The kitchen was fully equipped, and there are plenty of upscale eateries close by. The grounds were gorgeous with a fruit orchard and a beautiful pool and spa. Every room was beautifully decorated - it was like our own 5-star resort. Every member of the staff made me promise to rent this same property for our next retreat. Having said that, we will be back soon!"

reviews.title: Quiet Weekend Away
reviews.comment: "This house was absolutely amazing! It's spacious, beautifully decorated, private, and the perfect spot for a quiet weekend away. We loved all the thoughtful, clean, and elegant decor inside the home and the pristine pool outside! Everything was very easy to operate and the stay was stress-free. We can't wait to come back!"

reviews.title: Just Perfect
reviews.comment: "WOW - what an incredible vacation home! We were lucky enough to be Jen and Spencer's first guests at their newest vacation property and we were completely blown away! This house was clean, modern and luxurious. All kitchen appliances were brand new and was stocked with everything we needed to cook and entertain for the weekend. The beds were very comfortable with the softest linens and comfy mattresses - we even asked Jen where we could purchase them for our own home, haha. The living area was perfect - they have this incredibly cool media wall with a huge TV, bose sound bar for us to enjoy our music and a modern fireplace. We spent a ton of time outside around the pool too. They have 2 dining tables which was perfect for al fresco dinging under the stars and plenty of covered lounge seating during the day. Just perfect. It's hard to find a 7-bedroom home in this area and we completed lucked out finding this place!"
